blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Data video is a media form that integrates data visualization with video narrative, widely adopted in news reporting and business analysis. Compared with general video understanding, data video understanding places greater emphasis on accurately reading data from animated charts, integrating evidence across charts and time, and understanding how narrative organization and visual design communicate information. Yet existing benchmarks target either general videos or static charts, and data video understanding has not been systematically evaluated. We present DataVista, the first benchmark for data video understanding, containing 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 evaluation questions organized under a three-level progressive capability framework (data perception, temporal reasoning, narrative understanding) with 10 fine-grained question types across five topic domains. Systematic evaluation of 19 mainstream MLLMs shows that the best-performing model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, achieves 70.0% overall accuracy, still far below human expert performance, with models performing worst on Causal Reasoning and Narrative Structure. Increasing frame counts and adding subtitles mainly benefit data perception and temporal reasoning, with limited gains in narrative understanding. Further analysis of model responses identifies typical failure modes in chart reading, evidence judgment, and instruction understanding. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista.
blocks.zh: 数据视频是一种将数据可视化与视频叙事相结合的媒体形式,广泛应用于新闻报道和商业分析. 与一般的视频理解相比,数据视频理解更强调从动画图表中准确读取数据,将跨图表和时间的证据整合,以及理解叙事组织和视觉设计如何传递信息. 然而,现有的基准既针对一般录像,也针对静态图表,而数据录像了解情况尚未得到系统评价。 我们提出DataVista,这是数据视频理解的第一个基准,包含961个真实世界数据视频和6 775个评价问题,在一个三级渐进能力框架(数据感知,时间推理,叙事理解)下组织,涉及五个主题领域的10个精细问题类型. 对19个主流MLLMs的系统评价表明,表现最好的模型双子座-3.1-Pro达到70.0%的整体精度,仍然远低于人类专家的性能,模型在因果理性和叙述结构上表现最差. 增加帧数和增加字幕,主要有利于数据感知和时间推理,在叙事理解方面收益有限. 对模型反应的进一步分析确定了图读、证据判断和指令理解方面的典型故障模式。 该基准可在https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Data videos are a media form that integrates data visualization with video narrative, conveying data-driven stories over time through animation, narration, and scene transitions ( Amini et al., 2015 ; Shi et al., 2021 ; Shen et al., 2025b ) .
In recent years, organizations such as Bloomberg Graphics, NYT The Upshot, and Vox have produced a growing volume of such content, establishing data videos as an important medium for data journalism, business reporting, and science communication ( Yang et al., 2022 ; Cheng et al., 2022 ) .
Data videos provide a challenging setting for evaluating the combined capabilities of MLLMs in dynamic visual perception, cross-temporal reasoning, and narrative understanding.
blocks.zh:
数据视频是一种将数据可视化与视频叙事相结合的媒体形式,通过动画,叙事,和场景过渡传递数据驱动的故事(Amini等,2015;Shi等,2021;沈等,2025b.).
近年来,Bloomberg Graphics,NYT The Upshot,和Vox等组织制作了越来越多的此类内容,将数据视频确立为数据新闻,商业报道和科学传播的重要媒介(杨等,2022;程等,2022).
数据视频为评价MLLMs在动态视觉感知,跨时空推理,和叙事理解中的综合能力提供了一个具有挑战性的环境.

blocks.en:
However, understanding data videos goes well beyond what general video perception covers.
As shown in Figure 1 , charts are presented within continuous videos rather than provided as isolated images ( Thompson et al., 2020 ) ; key information is often distributed across multiple time points ( Li et al., 2026c ) ; and visual presentation also organizes narratives and communicates information ( Tang et al., 2026c ; Li et al., 2024b ) .
General video understanding benchmarks (Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , MVBench ( Li et al., 2024c ) ) focus on perception and reasoning over general video content, whereas static visualization benchmarks (ChartQA ( Masry et al., 2022 ) , VisJudge-Bench ( Xie et al., 2026c ) ) primarily address the understanding and evaluation of static charts. Jointly assessing evidence localization, cross-chart integration, and narrative understanding within continuous videos still lacks systematic benchmark support.
blocks.zh:
然而,理解数据视频远远超出了一般视频感知所覆盖的范围.
如图1所示,图表是在连续视频中显示的,而不是作为孤立图像提供(Thompson等,2020年;关键信息往往分布在多个时点(Li等,2026c;视觉展示也组织叙事并传递信息(Tang等,2026c;Li等,2024b.)).
一般视频理解基准(Video-MME(Fu等,2025年),MV Bench(Li等,2024年c))侧重于对一般视频内容的认知和推理,而静态可视化基准(CartQA(Masry等,2022年),VisJudge-Bench) (谢等,2026c.)主要论述静态图的理解和评价. 联合评估证据本地化、跨图集成和连续视频中的叙事理解仍然缺乏系统的基准支持。

blocks.en:
To fill this gap, we present DataVista , the first benchmark for data video understanding.
Drawing on Bloom’s cognitive taxonomy ( Bloom et al., 1956 ) , visualization literacy assessment frameworks ( Boy et al., 2014 ; Lee et al., 2017 ) , and design spaces for data storytelling ( Segel and Heer, 2010 ) , we systematically analyze the core abilities required for data video understanding and distill three progressive capability dimensions: data perception (accurately reading values and identifying visual elements from video frames), temporal reasoning (integrating information across time points and across charts), and narrative understanding (grasping the creator’s visual design intent and argument organization).
These three levels form a progressive evaluation framework comprising 10 fine-grained question types.
blocks.zh:
为了填补这一空白,我们提出了DataVista 数据视频理解的第一个基准。
根据Bloom的认知分类学(Bloom等,1956年),可视化识字评估框架(Boy等,2014年;Lee等,2017年),以及数据故事设计空间(Segel和Heer,2010年),我们系统地分析数据视频理解和分解三个进步能力维度所需的核心能力:数据感知(精确地读取值并识别视频帧的视觉要素),时间推理(将信息跨时间点和跨图表整合),以及叙事理解(给创作者的视觉设计意图和论证组织).
这三级构成了由10个精细问题类型组成的渐进评价框架。

blocks.en:
DataVista contains 961 professionally produced data videos from real-world sources, spanning five topic domains (Economy, Society, Science, Politics, and Culture), paired with 6,775 evaluation questions, all in multiple-choice format including both single- and multi-select items.
Using DataVista , we systematically evaluate 19 mainstream MLLMs. The results show that even the most advanced model, Gemini-3.1-Pro (70.0% accuracy), lags significantly behind human performance, with Causal Reasoning and Narrative Structure being the weakest question types across all models. Furthermore, the benefits of increasing frame counts and adding subtitles vary across capability levels, with relatively limited gains in narrative understanding. Error analysis further reveals typical failure modes in chart reading, evidence judgment, and instruction understanding.
blocks.zh:
DataVista包含961个专业制作的数据视频,来自现实世界,涉及五个主题领域(经济、社会、科学、政治和文化),配对了6,775个评价问题,均采用多选择格式,包括单选和多选项目。
我们利用DataVista系统评估了19个主流的MLLMs。 结果显示,即使是最先进的模型双子座-3.1-Pro(精确度为70.0%)也大大落后于人类的性能,而"Causal Reasoning"和"叙述结构"是所有模型中最弱的问题类型. 此外,增加帧数和增加字幕的好处因能力级别而异,在叙事理解方面进展相对有限。 出错分析进一步揭示出图读取,证据判断,以及指令理解等典型故障模式.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We present DataVista , containing 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 evaluation questions, as the first dedicated benchmark for data video understanding. • We design a three-level progressive capability framework with 10 fine-grained question types to systematically evaluate abilities ranging from chart reading and cross-chart evidence integration to understanding narrative and visual design. • We systematically evaluate 19 mainstream MLLMs and analyze how performance differs across capability levels, input settings, and error modes.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们介绍DataVista,其中包含961个真实世界的数据视频和6 775个评价问题,作为数据视频理解的第一个专用基准。 我们设计了一个三级渐进能力框架,有10个精细的问题类型,以系统评价从图表阅读和跨图表证据整合到理解叙述和外观设计的各种能力。 我们系统地评价19个主流的MLLM,并分析不同能力级别、输入设置和出错模式之间的性能差异。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Existing benchmarks evaluate multimodal understanding, temporal reasoning, and long-video comprehension.
Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) and Video-MME-v2 ( Fu et al., 2026 ) cover diverse video content and input modalities; MVBench ( Li et al., 2024c ) , NExT-QA ( Xiao et al., 2021 ) , and EgoSchema ( Mangalam et al., 2023 ) examine temporal, causal, and long-range reasoning.
LongVideoBench ( Wu et al., 2024a ) , LVBench ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , MLVU ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and Neptune ( Nagrani et al., 2024 ) further assess understanding over long videos.
Specialized benchmarks address human-centric perception and cognition ( Cai et al., 2025 ) , video aesthetics ( Li et al., 2026f ) , and driving-scene understanding ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) .
In contrast, DataVista focuses on quantitative evidence in data videos, evaluating how models read dynamically presented chart information, integrate evidence across charts, and understand how this evidence supports the video’s claims.
blocks.zh:
现有基准评价多式联运理解、时间推理和长视频理解。
Video-MME (Fu等,2025年)和Video-MME-v2(Fu等,2026年)涵盖多种视频内容和输入模式;MV Bench (Li等,2024年c),NExT-QA (Xiao等,2021年),和EgoSchema (Mangalam等,2023年)考察时间,因果,和远程推理.
Long Video Bench (Wu等,2024a.),LV Bench (Wang等,2024.),MLVU (Zhou等,2025.),和Neptune (Nagrani等,2024.)进一步评估了对长视频的理解.
专门基准涉及以人为中心的认知和认知(Cai等,2025年),视频美学(Li等,2026年f月)和驾驶-场理解(Zeng等,2025年).
相比之下,DataVista专注于数据视频中的定量证据,评价模型如何动态地读取图表信息,综合跨图表的证据,并理解这些证据如何支持视频的说法.

blocks.en:
Chart understanding benchmarks have progressed from visual question answering on individual charts to multi-chart and higher-order reasoning.
ChartQA ( Masry et al., 2022 ) , PlotQA ( Methani et al., 2020 ) , and ChartInsights ( Wu et al., 2024b ) assess visual and logical reasoning over static charts; ChartQAPro ( Masry et al., 2025 ) and RWA-ChartQA ( Hutchinson et al., 2025 ) introduce more diverse, real-world-oriented questions; and MultiChartQA ( Zhu et al., 2025c ) extends to multi-hop reasoning across chart collections.
Adjacent tasks cover chart summarization, comparison, and retrieval (Chart-to-Text ( Kantharaj et al., 2022 ) , ChartCards ( Wu et al., 2025a ) , ChartDiff ( Ye, 2026 ) , LineNet ( Luo et al., 2021c ) ) and visualization quality assessment (VisJudge-Bench ( Xie et al., 2026c ) and IGenBench ( Tang et al., 2026a ) ).
Across all these settings, charts are either isolated images or pre-assembled static collections. DataVista moves evaluation to dynamically presented charts in narrated video: models must read values from video frames, integrate evidence as it accumulates over time, and reason about how narrative structure and visual design convey the video’s argument.
blocks.zh:
图表理解基准从单个图表上的视觉问题回答到多图和更高顺序的推理都有所进步.
ChartQA(Masry等,2022年),PlotQA(Methani等,2020年),和Chart Insights(Wu等,2024年b)在静态图上评估视觉和逻辑推理;ChartQAPro(Masry等,2025年)和RWA-ChartQA(Hutchinson等,2025年)引入了更多样化,面向现实世界的问题;和多ChartQA(Zhu等,2025年c)延伸至跨图表集的多跳推理.
相邻的任务包括图表汇总、比较和检索(图到图文(Kantharaj等,2022年),图卡(Wu等,2025年a),图迪夫(叶,2026年),线网(罗等,2021年c))和可视化质量评估(VisJudge-Bench(Xie等,2026年c)和IGen Bench(Tang等,2026年a)).
在所有这些设置中,图表要么是孤立的图像,要么是预先组装的静态集合. 数据 Vista将评价转移到在叙述视频中动态呈现出图表:模型必须从视频帧读取值,将证据随时间推移而积累,以及叙述结构和视觉设计如何传达视频论点的理由.

blocks.en:
Visualization authoring research covers the full pipeline from chart generation to recommendation and revision ( Qin et al., 2020 ; Luo et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2023 ) .
Natural language-driven approaches span generation benchmarks and models (nvBench ( Luo et al., 2021a ) , nvBench 2.0 ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , DeepVIS ( Shuai et al., 2025 ) , and ncNet ( Luo et al., 2021b ) ).
Automatic generation and recommendation systems (DeepEye ( Luo et al., 2018b ; Luo et al., 2018a ; Luo et al., 2022 ) , HAIChart ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , chart-plot ( Tang et al., 2026d ) , and sketch-plot ( Tang et al., 2026b ) ) and chart annotation and defect debugging ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) address the correctness and quality of produced artifacts.
The artifacts these systems produce form the building blocks of data videos, yet whether multimodal models can understand how charts function within dynamic, narrated sequences remains unevaluated. DataVista fills that gap: it examines whether models can read, integrate, and interpret the charts and narratives that authoring systems produce.
blocks.zh:
可视化作者研究涵盖从图表生成到推荐和修改的全部管道(秦等,2020;罗等,2024;沈等,2023.
自然语言驱动的方法跨越生成基准和模型(nv Bench (Luo等,2021a)),nv Bench 2.0 (Luo等,2025), DeepVIS (Shuai等,2025年),和ncNet (Luo等,2021b.).
自动生成和推荐系统(DeepEye (Luo等, 2018b;Luo等, 2018a;Luo等, 2022), HAICHart (Xie等, 2024)),图版 (Tang等, 2026d.),和草图(Tang等, 2026b.)和图表注释和缺陷调试(Chen等, 2025;Shen等, 2026.)解决出品文物的正确性和质量问题.
这些系统生成的文物构成了数据视频的构件,然而,多式联运模型是否能够理解图表如何在动态的,被描述的序列中运行,仍未得到评价. 数据 Vista填补了这一空白:它研究模型是否能够读取,整合,并解释作者系统所产生的图表和叙述.

blocks.en:
Data videos use animated visualizations and narration to communicate data stories.
Research has progressed from narrative visualization genres ( Segel and Heer, 2010 ) and video clip structure and viewer engagement ( Amini et al., 2017 ; Amini et al., 2018 ) to the narrative role of animation ( Shi et al., 2021 ) , story structure ( Wei et al., 2025 ) , and narration–animation coordination ( Cheng et al., 2022 ; Shen et al., 2024a ) .
Systems such as Data Player ( Shen et al., 2024b ) , DataMagic ( Xie et al., 2026a ; Xie et al., 2026b ) , and DeepEye ( Li et al., 2026d ; Li et al., 2026e ) support automated data video generation.
These studies focus on designing and generating data stories ( Zhu et al., 2025b ; Luo et al., 2026 ) , while DataVista examines whether models understand the data relationships and narrative expression within these stories, extending data video research from content creation to understanding evaluation.
blocks.zh:
数据视频使用动画可视化和解说来沟通数据故事.
研究从叙事可视化流派(Segel and Heer,2010年)和视频剪辑结构和取景者参与(Amini等,2017年;Amini等,2018年)到动画的叙事角色(Shi等,2021年),故事结构(Wei等,2025年)和叙事-动画协调(Cheng等,2022年;Shen等,2024年a).
数据播放器等系统(沈等,2024b), DataMagic (Xie等,2026a;Xie等,2026b)和DeepEye(Li等,2026d;Li等,2026e)支持自动数据视频生成.
这些研究侧重于设计和生成数据故事(Zhu等,2025b;Luo等,2026),而DataVista则研究模型是否理解这些故事中的数据关系和叙事表达,将数据视频研究从内容创建延伸到理解评价.

blocks.zh: 3 DataVista: 设计和建筑

blocks.en: 3.1 Video Collection and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 3.1 录像收集和预处理

blocks.en: Drawing on prior collection practices ( Yang et al., 2022 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) , we collect 5,604 candidate videos from YouTube through keyword search and channel-level scraping, covering professional media, data journalism, educational, and independent creator channels. Representative channels and search keywords are listed in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们通过关键词搜索和频道级的刮取,收集了来自YouTube的5 604个候选视频,涵盖专业媒体、数据新闻、教育和独立创建频道。 代表频道和搜索关键词列于附录B.1.

blocks.en: To support fine-grained topic-level evaluation, we draw on topic classifications in data journalism research ( Stalph, 2018 ; Loosen et al., 2020 ) to establish a two-level taxonomy with 5 domains (Economy, Society, Science, Politics, and Culture) and 22 subcategories, as shown in Figure 3 a. Videos first receive initial tags based on source channels and search keywords, then are assigned to categories using channel affiliation and title cues. The complete category mapping and subcategory distribution are provided in Appendix B.5 .
blocks.zh: 为了支持精细的课题级评价,我们借鉴了数据新闻学研究中的专题分类(Stalph, 2018; Loosen等, 2020),建立了分5个领域(经济,社会,科学,政治,文化)和22个子类的两级分类学,如图3a所示. 视频首先接收基于源频道和搜索关键字的初始标记,然后被分配到使用频道隶属关系和标题提示的类别. 完整的类别测绘和子类别分布见附录B.5。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 b, videos range from 28 seconds to 15 minutes, with a median of ≈ \approx 5.6 minutes, matching the typical narrative density reported for professional data videos ( Amini et al., 2015 ; Yang et al., 2022 ) . To reduce leakage risk, DataVista prioritizes recently published content, with approximately 68.5% of videos published in or after June 2025 (contamination analysis in Appendix E.9 ). For content quality, we use source credibility as the primary gate rather than a single engagement metric, and record view count only as a supplementary indicator. We further manually remove classic films, television episodes, and flagship content of top-tier creators, following the decontamination practice of recent video benchmarks ( Fu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 如图3b所示,视频从28秒到15分钟不等,中位数为\\\约5.6分钟,与专业数据视频报告的典型叙事密度相匹配(Amini等,2015;Yang等,2022.). 为了减少泄漏风险,DataVista将最近公布的内容列为优先事项,2025年6月或之后公布的视频约占68.5%(附录E.9中的污染分析)。 就内容质量而言,我们使用源信誉作为主要大门,而不是单一的接触指标,并记录只将它视为一个补充指标。 我们进一步手动删除经典电影,电视剧,以及顶级创作者的旗舰内容,遵循了近代视频基准的去污实践(Fu等,2026年).

blocks.en: 3.2 Capability Hierarchy
blocks.zh: 3.2 能力等级

blocks.en:
Understanding a data video requires coordinating multiple abilities, from perceiving data in individual frames, to integrating information across charts over time, to interpreting the creator’s narrative intent ( Segel and Heer, 2010 ; Amini et al., 2015 ) .
To characterize strengths and bottlenecks in this process, we follow Bloom’s Taxonomy ( Bloom et al., 1956 ) , which is widely used to guide assessment design and orders cognitive objectives from remembering and understanding toward analyzing and evaluating.
We accordingly organize the benchmark questions into three progressive levels comprising 10 fine-grained question types (complete definitions in Appendix A ).
blocks.zh:
理解数据视频需要协调多种能力,从在单个帧中查看数据,到跨图表整合信息,再到解释创作者的叙事意图(Segel and Heer,2010;Amini等人,2015年)。
为了描述这一过程的长处和瓶颈,我们遵循了Bloom的分类学(Bloom等人,1956年),该分类学被广泛用于指导评估设计和命令认知目标从记忆和理解到分析和评估。
因此,我们将基准问题分为由10个精细问题类型(附录A中的完整定义)组成的三个渐进层次。

blocks.en:
This foundational level assesses whether a model can locate relevant visual evidence in a video and read the data it contains, corresponding to the “reading” level in visualization literacy research ( Boy et al., 2014 ; Lee et al., 2017 ) . Unlike static chart question answering where the target chart is pre-isolated, relevant charts here appear within a continuous video containing multiple visual states, requiring the model to localize evidence before reading; answers do not depend on frame ordering.
It contains two question types: Data Fact Reading (reading and cross-frame aggregation of values, trends, and extrema) and Chart Element Recognition (chart type, axis, legend, and color encoding).
blocks.zh:
这一基础水平评估一个模型是否能够在视频中定位相关视觉证据并读取其包含的数据,与可视化扫盲研究中的"读取"水平相对应(Boy等,2014;Lee等,2017. 与静态图问题回答目标图被预同化的地方不同,这里的相关图出现在包含多视觉状态的连续视频中,要求模型在读取前将证据本地化;答案不取决于帧顺序.
它包含两个问题类型: 数据事实读取(读取和跨框架集合值,趋势,和extrema)和图元素识别(图类型,轴,图例,和颜色编码).

blocks.zh: 图3:DataVista数据集概览. (a) 显示五个主要领域及其子类别的分布的视频类等级。 (b) 以分分钟方式分发录像。 (c) 按评价级别排列的问题类型。

blocks.en: 3.3 Question Design
blocks.zh: 3.3 问题设计

blocks.en:
DataVista contains both four-option single-answer and multiple-select questions.
Given the inherently combinatorial nature of causal argumentation and narrative design in data videos ( Yang et al., 2022 ) , Causal Reasoning, Argument Synthesis, Narrative Structure, Visual Communication Intent, and Counterfactual Analysis often require models to identify the correct subset from multiple visual evidence items or design options, and multiple-select questions concentrate in these types.
Figure 3 c shows the distribution of question types across levels, with statistics on per-level question counts and the distribution of questions per video in Appendix B.10 .
blocks.zh:
DataVista既包含四可选择的单接答案,也包含多选题.
鉴于数据视频中因果论证和叙事设计固有的组合性(Yang等,2022年),Causal Reasoning,辩证合成,叙述结构,视觉通信意向,和反事实分析往往需要模型从多视觉证据项目或设计选项中识别出正确的子集,多选题集中在这些类型.
图3c显示问题类型在各个级别上的分布情况,附录B.10载有每级问题计数的统计数据和每段视频的问题分布情况。

blocks.en:
Each level follows differentiated distractor design principles.
L1 numerical questions include at least one numerically close distractor to test precise reading.
L2 cross-chart questions include at least one distractor that can be selected based on a single chart alone, reducing the shortcut of answering based on a single chart.
L3 narrative questions draw all options from real categories in the narrative design space for data videos ( Yang et al., 2022 ) , avoiding out-of-domain fake options.
Quality evaluation questions follow the Fidelity–Expressiveness–Aesthetics framework ( Xie et al., 2026c ) : all options share the same positive tone and differ only in the specific visual mechanism identified, reducing the shortcut of answering based on sentiment polarity.
The complete distractor design principles for each question type are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
每个级别都遵循不同的分心器设计原则。
L1数值问题包括至少一个数值相近的分心器来测试精确读取.
L2跨图题中至少包括一个能单独根据单一图表选择的分心器,减少了基于单一图表的解答快捷键.
L3叙事问题从数据视频的叙事设计空间中从真实类别中抽取出所有选项(Yang等,2022),避免了域外假选项.
质量评价问题遵循了"Fidelity - Expressive - Alectics 框架"(Xie等,2026c):所有选项都有着相同的正调,仅在所识别的具体视觉机制上有所不同,减少了基于情绪极性回答的捷径.
附录A为每个问题类型提供了完整的分心器设计原则。

blocks.en: 3.4 Expert Annotation and Quality Control
blocks.zh: 3.4 专家注释和质量控制

blocks.en:
The annotation workflow is illustrated in Figure 2 (Stages 2–3).
Five annotators with experience in data video production or data visualization research design the candidate questions. To assist this process, Gemini-3-Flash pre-extracts chart segments, key data points, narrative stages, and argument chapters (prompt and output schema in Appendix B.2 ). Annotators watch each video in full, verify and correct the extracted information segment by segment, supplement omissions, and mark timestamps for key data points. They then write question stems, options, and answers following the three-level capability framework and distractor design principles, with detailed specifications in Appendix A .
Annotation time per video ranges from approximately 1 to 2 hours, depending on video duration, chart density, and narrative complexity.
blocks.zh:
图2(Stages 2-3)说明了注释工作流程。
5位在数据视频制作或数据可视化研究方面有经验的注释员设计了候选问题. 为了协助这一过程,双子座-3-Flash预取图段,关键数据点,叙事阶段,和论证章节(附录B.2中的即时和输出计划). 注释员全面观看了每段视频,按片段核实和校正所提取的信息段,补充了遗漏,并标记了关键数据点的时间戳. 然后他们按照三级能力框架和分心器设计原则写出问题来源、选项和答案,并在附录A中详细说明。
每部视频的注释时间大约从一到二小时不等,这取决于视频的持续时间,图表密度和叙述的复杂性.

blocks.en: To reduce shortcuts that do not require video evidence ( Fu et al., 2026 ; Bian et al., 2025 ) , we provide Gemini-3-Flash with only question stems and options, filtering out candidates whose predicted answers exactly match the references. Across five representative models from different model families, filtered-out questions are also easier to answer from text alone, with accuracy 22.9–32.2 percentage points higher than on retained questions. Screening details and cross-model analysis are provided in Appendix B.3.1 .
blocks.zh: 为了减少不需要视频证据的捷径(Fu等,2026;Bian等,2025),我们只向双子座-3-Flash提供问题源和选项,过滤出其预测答案与参考文献完全吻合的候选人. 在来自不同模范家庭的五个代表性模型中,过滤出的问题也比较容易从文本中解答,准确度比保留的问题高出22.9-32.2个百分点。 筛选细节和跨模型分析见附录B.3.1。

blocks.en: Four reviewers who did not participate in question design review the candidates retained after text-only filtering. Tasks are assigned by video, with two reviewers separately checking each question’s wording, video evidence for the answer, and distractors. Disagreements are discussed against the original video; revised questions are rechecked and those still ambiguous are removed. Among candidates retained after text-only filtering, 80.1% pass review, 15.4% pass after manual revision, and 4.5% are rejected. The final dataset contains 6,775 questions covering 961 videos. The complete review procedure, level-specific criteria, and statistics are provided in Appendix B.3.2 .
blocks.zh: 四名没有参加问题设计审查的评审员对只经过文本过滤后保留的候选人进行审查。 任务通过视频来分配,两名审查员分别检查每个问题的措辞,回答的视频证据以及分心者. 与原视频对分歧进行讨论;对修改后的问题进行再检查并去掉仍然含糊不清的问题. 在经过文本过滤后留用的候选人中,80.1%通过审查,15.4%通过人工修订,4.5%被拒绝。 最终数据集包含6,775个问题,涵盖961个视频. 完整的审查程序、具体级别的标准和统计数据载于附录B.3.2。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate 19 MLLMs, comprising five closed-source and 14 open-source models. The open-source models span the Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025a ) , Qwen2.5-VL ( Bai et al., 2025b ) , InternVL3.5 ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , and InternVL3 ( Zhu et al., 2025a ) families, with Instruct variants used for the Qwen models. Table 1 lists all model variants. Unless noted otherwise, later diagnostic analyses in this section use five representative models: Gemini-3.1-Pro, GPT-5, Claude-Sonnet-4.6, Qwen3-VL-32B, and InternVL3.5-38B.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了19个MLLM,包括5个闭源模型和14个开源模型. 开源模型跨越了Quen3-VL(Bai等,2025a.),Quen2.5-VL(Bai等,2025b.),InternVL3.5(Wang等,2025b.)和InternVL3(Zhu等,2025a.)等家族,并使用教义变体来进行Quen模型. 表1列出了所有模式变体. 除另有说明外,本节后期诊断分析采用有代表性的五种模式:双子座-3.1-Pro,GPT-5,克洛德-索内特-4.6,Qune3-VL-32B和InternVL3.5-38B.

blocks.en: To compare models under a uniform visual budget, the main evaluation provides all models with question stems, answer options, and 50 frames uniformly sampled from the full video, without audio. We use the same frame set for conditions without and with subtitles, adding subtitle text in the latter. Models provide answers together with supporting reasons. The impact of varying frame budgets and native video inputs is reported in Section 4.4 and Appendix E.2 , with evaluation details in Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh: 为了在统一的视觉预算下比较模型,主要评价提供了所有模型,其中包含有"问源","答案选项",以及50帧统一取自全视频的样本,没有音频. 我们使用相同的框架来设定没有字幕的条件,并在字幕中添加字幕文本。 模型提供了答案和佐证理由。 第4.4节和附录E.2报告了不同框架预算和原生视频投入的影响,附录D.1介绍了评价细节。

blocks.en: We use per-question exact-match accuracy: single-select answers must be correct, and multi-select predictions must exactly match the ground-truth option set. Overall accuracy is computed by pooling responses from the conditions with and without subtitles. For multi-select questions, we also report option-level precision, recall, and F1 to assess partially correct responses (Appendix E.5 ). Uncertainty estimation is described in Appendix D.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用每个问题精确匹配的精确度:单选答案必须正确,多选取的预测必须与设定的地-真选项完全匹配. 总体准确度的计算是通过将各种条件的答复与字幕和无字幕结合起来。 对于多选择的问题,我们也报告选项级的精确度,回想,以及F1来评估部分正确的答复(附录E.5.). 附录D.3说明了不确定性估计。

blocks.en: Six evaluators watch complete videos and listen to the original audio. Questions are assigned by video, with two independent answers per question. Those who wrote or finally reviewed a question do not answer it. Scoring follows the same criterion as for the models.
blocks.zh: 6名评审员观看完整视频并收听原声. 问题通过视频指定,每个问题有两个独立的答案. 那些写出或最后审查一个问题的人不回答这个问题。 分红遵循与模型相同的标准.

blocks.en: 4.2 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 4.2 总体业绩

blocks.en: Table 1: Exact-match accuracy (%) on DataVista . w/o Sub. and w/ Sub. use the same 50 sampled frames without audio, without and with subtitles; Avg Acc weights the three levels by question count, and Overall pools both conditions. Human evaluation uses complete videos with original audio.
blocks.zh: 表1:DataVista .w/o Sub.和w/Sub.上的精确匹配精确度(%)使用相同的50个没有音频,没有字幕的抽样帧;Avg Acc按问数对三个级别进行加权,总体集合两个条件. 人评价使用带原声的完整视频.

blocks.en: Human evaluators achieve 91.7% overall accuracy, with 97.1%, 89.0%, and 86.8% at L1, L2, and L3, respectively. They perform near ceiling on L1 data reading and maintain high accuracy on temporal reasoning and narrative understanding. Exact agreement between paired responses is 88.6% overall and 95.5%, 85.7%, and 81.3% across the three levels.
blocks.zh: 人类评价人员总体准确度达到91.7%,L1、L2和L3分别为97.1%、89.0%和86.8%。 它们在L1数据读取上进行接近上限的工作,在时间推理和叙事理解上保持高精度. 配对答复之间的确切协议总体为88.6%,95.5%、85.7%和81.3%。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , Gemini-3.1-Pro and GPT-5 achieve overall accuracies of 70.0% and 67.4%, respectively, with the former still 21.7 percentage points below the human baseline. The strongest open-source model, Qwen3-VL-32B, reaches 57.3%, trailing Gemini-3.1-Pro by 12.7 points. Its Thinking mode raises overall accuracy to 62.9%, still below the leading closed-source models. Gains are concentrated in temporal reasoning, without corresponding improvement in narrative understanding. Per-level results and analysis of both modes are provided in Appendix E.3 . With subtitles, equal weighting across the five domains leaves the ranking of the five representative models unchanged (Appendix E.1 ).
blocks.zh: 如表1所显示,双子座-3.1-Pro和GPT-5分别实现了70.0%和67.4%的总加速率,前者仍然低于人类基线21.7个百分点。 最强开源型号为Quen3-VL-32B,达到57.3%,以12.7分落后于双子座-3.1-Pro. 它的思维模式将总体精度提高到62.9%,仍然低于领先的闭源模型. 收益集中在时间推理上,在叙事理解方面没有相应的改进. 附录E.3提供了两种模式的每级结果和分析。 通过字幕,5个域的等分权使得5个代表性模型的排名保持不变(附录E.1.

blocks.en: Adding subtitles raises overall accuracy by a median of 3.1 percentage points across the 19 models, with the largest gain of 5.1 points for Qwen3-VL-32B; Section 4.3 analyzes how subtitles affect the individual capability levels. Random selection and the most-frequent-answer baseline score 20.8% and 27.5%, respectively; their settings and per-level results are provided in Appendix D.2 .
blocks.zh: 添加字幕使整个19个模型的总精度以3.1个百分点的中位数上升,而Qwen3-VL-32B的最大收益为5.1分; 第4.3节分析字幕如何影响个人的能力水平. 随机选择和最经常回答的基线分数分别为20.8%和27.5%;其设置和每个级别的结果载于附录D.2。

blocks.en: Temporal reasoning is particularly discriminative in these model comparisons. Gemini-3.1-Pro leads Qwen3-VL-32B by 25.3 percentage points on L2, compared with 10.3 points on L1 and 4.2 on L3. On L3 the gap lies mainly between models and humans: the highest accuracy reached by any model is 81.8% on L1, 15.3 percentage points below humans, but only 59.2% on L3, where the gap widens to 27.6 points.
blocks.zh: 在这些模型比较中,时间推理特别具有歧视性。 双子座-3.1-Pro领先了Qwen3-VL-32B在L2上的25.3个百分点,而L1上的10.3分和L3上的4.2分. 在L3上,差距主要位于模型和人类之间:任何模型达到的最高精度为:L1上81.8%,比人类低15.3%;而L3上只有59.2%,差距会扩大至27.6%.

blocks.en: Given complete videos with their original audio tracks, Gemini-3.1-Pro and Gemini-3-Flash achieve overall accuracies of 73.5% and 68.9%, respectively, both below the human score of 91.7%. On narrative understanding, they score 59.4% and 55.9%, respectively, leaving a substantial gap to the human score of 86.8%. Detailed comparisons and cases are provided in Appendix E.2 .
blocks.zh: 双子座-3.1-Pro和双子座-3-Flash凭借其原声道的完整视频,分别实现73.5%和68.9%的整体加速率,均低于91.7%的人类得分. 根据叙事理解,他们分别得分59.4%和55.9%,给人类86.8%的得分留下了巨大的差距. 附录E.2提供了详细的比较和案例。

blocks.en: 4.3 Input Evidence Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 投入证据分析

blocks.en: To examine the contributions of frames and subtitles, we compare the five representative models under four input conditions: questions only, questions with subtitles, questions with frames, and questions with both frames and subtitles. All conditions include answer options and exclude audio. Figure 4 reports the results.
blocks.zh: 为了审查帧和字幕的贡献,我们在四个输入条件下比较了五个代表性模型:只问问题,有字幕的问题,有帧的问题,以及有帧和字幕的问题. 所有条件包括答案选项并排除音频. 图4报告了结果。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Exact-match accuracy (%) of five models under question-only and frame inputs, by level. Colored segments show the change after adding subtitles (percentage points).
blocks.zh: 图4:按级别列出的5个模型的精确匹配精度(%),仅问和帧输入. 有色片段在添加字幕后显示变化(百分比分).

blocks.en: The contribution of frames decreases across levels. Relative to questions alone, adding frames raises mean L1 accuracy across the five models from 39.4% to 71.4%, a gain of 32.0 percentage points, compared with 14.7 on L2 and 5.1 on L3 (from 48.0% to 53.1%). On L1, frames alone also outperform questions with subtitles (46.7%) by 24.7 points, highlighting the importance of visual chart information for basic data reading. These findings indicate that adding frames primarily improves basic chart reading, with relatively limited gains in narrative understanding.
blocks.zh: 各个级别框架的贡献会减少。 仅就问题而言,加框就提高了5个模型的平均L1精度,从39.4%提高到71.4%,增长32.0个百分点,而L2为14.7%,L3为5.1(从48.0%提高到53.1%)。 在L1上,单帧还比副标题(46.7%)的问题多出24.7分,突出了视觉图信息对基础数据读取的重要性. 这些调查结果表明,添加帧主要能改善基本图表读取,在叙事理解方面的收益相对有限.

blocks.en: Subtitles provide the largest supplementary gain for temporal reasoning. Adding subtitles to frames raises mean L2 accuracy from 52.6% to 59.1%, a gain of 6.5 percentage points, compared with 2.9 on L1 and 2.4 on L3. Joint input also outperforms questions with subtitles alone by 13.1 points, indicating that frames and subtitles provide complementary information for temporal reasoning.
blocks.zh: 字幕为时间推理提供了最大的补充收益. 在帧上添加字幕,平均L2精度由52.6%提高到59.1%,增收了6.5个百分点,而L1的为2.9分,L3的为2.4分. 联合输入还比仅副标题的问题高出13.1分,表明帧和副标题为时间推理提供了补充信息.

blocks.en: Subtitles can also narrow performance gaps between short and long videos. For GPT-5, adding subtitles raises accuracy on videos longer than 9 minutes from 59.4% to 66.9%, reducing the gap from the shortest-video group from 8.9 to 1.4 percentage points. Duration-group results for all models are provided in Appendix E.6 .
blocks.zh: 字幕还可以缩小短视频和长视频的性能差距. 对于GPT-5,添加了字幕,将超过9分钟的视频精度从59.4%提高到66.9%,将最短视频组的差距从8.9个百分点降至1.4个百分点. 所有模型的期限分组结果载于附录E.6。

blocks.en: 4.4 Frame Budget Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 框架预算敏感性

blocks.en: Figure 5: Exact-match accuracy across frame budgets without subtitles or audio.
blocks.zh: 图5:没有字幕或音频的全帧预算精确匹配精度.

blocks.en: Having compared the contributions of frames and subtitles, we further examine the effect of visual sampling density by comparing five representative models at frame budgets of 8, 16, 32, and 50. Frames are sampled at the midpoints of equal temporal segments across the full video, without subtitles or audio.
blocks.zh: 在比较了框架和字幕的贡献之后,我们进一步审查了视觉取样密度的影响,比较了框架预算8、16、32和50的五个代表性模型。 框架在全视频的等时段中点取样,没有字幕或音频。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 5 , increasing the frame budget improves overall accuracy and changes which models lead. GPT-5 performs best at 8 and 16 frames, whereas Gemini-3.1-Pro leads at 32 and 50 frames. Among the open-source models, InternVL3.5-38B leads at lower budgets, whereas Qwen3-VL-32B performs better at higher budgets.
blocks.zh: 如图5所示,增加框架预算可提高总体准确性并改变哪些模式。 GPT-5最佳表现为8和16帧,而双子座-3.1-Pro领先32和50帧. 在开放源代码模式中,InternVL3.5-38B领先于更低的预算,而Qune3-VL-32B在较高预算方面表现更好.

blocks.en: Basic data perception is more sensitive to sampling density. Increasing the budget from 8 to 32 frames raises mean L1 accuracy across the five models by 11.6 percentage points, compared with 4.7 on L2 and 2.1 on L3. With 100 frames, L1 can still benefit, whereas L2 and L3 show no consistent improvement (Appendix E.4 ). These results indicate that increasing the number of sampled frames primarily improves chart reading, with more limited gains in temporal reasoning and narrative understanding.
blocks.zh: 基本数据感知对采样密度更为敏感. 将预算从8个框架增加到32个框架,使5个模型的平均L1准确度提高了11.6%,而L2为4.7个,L3为2.1个。 有了100帧,L1仍然可以受益,而L2和L3则没有表现出一致的改进(附录E.4.). 这些结果显示,增加被抽样的帧数主要能改善图表读取,在时间推理和叙事理解方面的得益更有限.

blocks.en: 4.5 Capability Dimension Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 能力尺寸分析

blocks.en: We further compare the five representative models across ten question types to examine differences within each capability level (Figure 6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们进一步比较了10个问题类型的5个代表性模型,以审查每个能力级别内的差异(图6)。

blocks.en: With both frames and subtitles, mean accuracy is 73.6% on Cross-Temporal Change and 62.6% on Cross-Chart Comparison, compared with 39.2% on Causal Reasoning and 53.9% on Argument Synthesis; even the best model reaches only 44.2% on Causal Reasoning. Unlike tracking changes or comparing values, the latter two tasks require identifying which data support a specified causal relationship or the central argument and selecting the complete set of supporting evidence. These two types also benefit most from subtitles, gaining 8.5 and 16.6 percentage points, respectively, compared with at most 4.1 for the other two types.

Across the five models, accuracy on Cross-Temporal Change ranges from 56.0% to 87.8%, but all score between 46.9% and 51.0% on Narrative Structure. These questions further require understanding how data are organized into a narrative and how arguments connect across chapters. Within L3, Counterfactual Analysis averages 63.3% and Narrative Structure averages 49.6%, indicating that the difficulty of L3 concentrates on understanding narrative structure.
blocks.zh: 在五种模型中,跨时空变化的精度在56.0%至87.8%之间,但在叙述结构中均得分在46.9%至51.0%之间. 这些问题还需要了解如何将数据编为叙述,以及各种论点如何相互连接。 在L3中,反事实分析平均为63.3%,叙述结构平均为49.6%,这表明L3的难度集中在理解叙述结构上.

blocks.en: For the multi-select questions within these task types, we supplement exact match with option-level F1 to distinguish partially correct from fully correct answers (Appendix E.5 ). With subtitles, Argument Synthesis reaches 88.0% F1 but 53.9% exact match, indicating that many responses are only partially correct and that fully correct answers remain challenging. Even with partial credit, Causal Reasoning has the lowest F1 among the five multi-select types.

blocks.en: 4.6 Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.6 错误分析

blocks.en: Following diagnostic frameworks from chart question answering and video understanding ( Masry et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2025c ; Fu et al., 2025 ) , we manually inspect 120 randomly sampled incorrect responses from Gemini-3.1-Pro under 50-frame input with subtitles and group them into perception, reasoning, and instruction understanding.
blocks.zh: 根据图表问答和视频理解的诊断框架(Masry等人,2022年;Zhu等人,2025年c;Fu等人,2025年),我们手动检查120个随机抽取的双子座-3.1-Pro在50个框架输入下的不正确答复,并配有字幕,将它们组合成感知、推理和教学理解。

blocks.en: The most common cases are value and text reading errors (36.7%), such as reading the Nintendo Wii first-three-year sales total as 45 million rather than about 20 million. The remaining cases include confused visual mappings (5.0%), reversed trends or rankings (3.3%), and chart-structure errors such as misjudged axis scales (2.5%). These errors occur with the relevant frames already available, indicating that accurately extracting chart information remains a bottleneck in data video understanding.
blocks.zh: 最常见的案例是价值和文本读取错误(36.7%),例如读取任天堂Wii的初三年销量总计为4500万而非约2000万. 所余案例包括模糊的视觉映射(5.0%),倒转趋势或排名(3.3%),以及图表结构出错如误判轴平面(2.5%)等. 这些错误随着已有的相关框架而发生,表明准确提取图表信息仍然是数据视频理解的一个瓶颈.

blocks.en: After chart facts have been extracted, the main difficulty lies in building logical relations. Pure arithmetic errors are rare (0.8%); more common are cross-chart linking (4.2%) and evidence judgment (37.5%). On causal reasoning and argument synthesis in particular, the model often reads the chart facts correctly but fails to judge whether a given fact supports a specified claim, indicating that it still struggles to connect observed data with the narrative argument.
blocks.zh: 在提取出图表事实后,主要困难在于建立逻辑关系. 纯粹的算术错误是罕见的(0.8%);比较常见的是交叉图连接(4.2%)和证据判断(37.5%). 特别是在因果推理和论证综合方面,模型往往正确读取了图表事实,但未能判断某一特定事实是否支持特定的说法,表明它仍然难以将观测到的数据与叙述性论证联系起来.

blocks.en: These errors do not arise from failing to read the chart, but from not following constraints in the question: the model shifts the specified time range or target object (5.0%), maps an otherwise reasonable conclusion to the wrong option (3.3%), or overlooks a restriction on the evidence source (1.7%), for instance selecting a narrated revenue target when the question asks for chart-specific facts.
blocks.zh: 这些错误不是因为没有读取图表,而是因为没有遵守问题的限制:模型将指定的时间范围或目标对象(5.0%)转移,将本来合理的结论映射到错误的选项(3.3%),或者忽略了对证据来源的限制(1.7%),例如在问题询问图表特定事实时选择一个叙述性收入目标.

blocks.en: Further analysis of Qwen3-VL-32B also identifies cases where the model correctly reads chart facts but misjudges whether they support the claim in the question; detailed diagnostics are provided in Appendix E.8 . Error cases for Gemini-3.1-Pro and example questions across capability levels are provided in Appendix E.7 and Appendix C , respectively.
blocks.zh: 对Qune3-VL-32B的进一步分析还查明了模型正确阅读了图表事实但错误判断它们是否支持问题中的说法的情况;附录E.8提供了详细的诊断。 附录E.7和附录C分别提供了双子体-3.1-Pro和跨能力水平的示例问题。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present DataVista , the first benchmark for data video understanding, comprising 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 questions across three capability levels and 10 question types. Evaluation of 19 MLLMs reveals a substantial gap from human performance, with persistent difficulties in identifying evidence for causal claims and understanding narratives. DataVista provides a foundation for systematically evaluating and improving data video understanding.
blocks.zh: 包括961个真实世界的数据视频和6 775个问题, 对19起最低生活水平评估显示,与人类业绩存在很大差距,在查明因果关系的证据和理解叙述方面始终存在困难。 数据 Vista为系统评价和改进数据视频理解提供了基础.

blocks.en: AI use statement

We did not use generative AI to create synthetic data, propose theoretical models or mathematical claims, write proofs, or introduce novel algorithmic ideas or academic claims. blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work introduces DataVista, an academic benchmark for data video understanding. The source videos used to construct this benchmark were collected from public video platforms (e.g., YouTube). To advance research on multimodal large language models in this emerging domain, we open-source all high-quality annotations meticulously created by our team, including question-answer pairs, evidence timestamps, and structured metadata. The copyright of all source videos belongs to their respective original creators or rightsholders, and this benchmark along with its open-source data is intended solely for academic research. Furthermore, during the dataset construction process, we ensured that all participating domain experts received fair compensation. The data collection and annotation procedures of this study have been reviewed and approved by our institutional ethics board. We hope DataVista will serve as a valuable evaluation tool to promote the development of automated data visualization assessment and understanding technologies.

blocks.en: A.1 Design Rationale
blocks.zh: A.1 设计理由

blocks.en: The three progressive levels and ten question types in DataVista are designed around capability organization and evidence requirements.
blocks.zh: DataVista的3个进步级别和10个问题类型是围绕能力组织和证据要求设计的.

blocks.en: The three levels are distinguished by the judgments required: L1 focuses on reading data facts and chart elements; L2 on data relationships and evidential support across charts and time points; and L3 on how this information is organized into a narrative and how visual design serves communication. This design draws on the visualization literacy frameworks proposed by Boy et al. (2014) and Lee et al. (2017) , extending them to cross-chart relationships and narrative context in data videos. For example, Argument Synthesis focuses on identifying key data supporting the central claim, whereas Narrative Structure focuses on the roles and organization of different segments within the overall argument.
blocks.zh: 这三层由需要的判断来区分:L1侧重于读取数据事实和图表元素;L2侧重于跨图表和时点的数据关系和证据支持;L3侧重于如何将这些信息组织成一个叙事以及视觉设计如何为通信服务. 这一设计借鉴了Boy等人(2014年)和Lee等人(2017年)提出的可视化扫盲框架,将其扩展到了数据视频中的跨图关系和叙事上下文. 例如,辩证综合侧重于确定支持中心主张的关键数据,而陈述结构则侧重于总体论证中不同部分的作用和组织.

blocks.en: Evidence requirements depend on the specific task. Value retrieval typically relies on the relevant chart state ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , cross-chart comparison requires combining data from different charts, and narrative and design judgments also require the corresponding context ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Questions about animation or presentation order require examining how the visual content changes over time. Multiple frames support aggregation or comparison, while order information supports judgments about change processes and narrative organization.
blocks.zh: 证据要求取决于具体任务。 价值检索一般依赖于相相关的图表状态(Yang等,2024年),跨图比较需要综合不同图表的数据,叙述和设计判断也需要相应的上下文(Wang等,2026年). 关于动画或展示顺序的问题需要研究视觉内容如何随时间变化. 多帧支持汇总或比较,而命令信息则支持对变化过程和叙事组织的判断.

blocks.en: Section A.2 specifies each question type’s definition, target competency, evidence requirements, and distractor design. Individual types can include multiple modes: Cross-Chart Comparison covers visual comparison and arithmetic derivation; Narrative Structure covers narrative patterns, data flow, and cross-section argumentation.
blocks.zh: A.2节规定了每个问题类型的定义、目标能力、证据要求和分心器设计。 个别类型可以包括多种模式: 跨图比较涵盖视觉比较和算术推导; 叙述结构涵盖叙事模式,数据流和截面论证.

blocks.en: The following gives a complete specification of all 10 question types. The Evidence field describes the visual information and context targeted by each question type, including relevant chart states, cross-chart evidence, and temporal or narrative relationships. Among these, Data Fact Reading, Cross-Temporal Change, Cross-Chart Comparison, and Narrative Structure each include multiple assessment modes, detailed in their respective definitions.

blocks.en: Level 1: Data Perception Data Fact Reading • Definition: Reading data information from charts, including four modes: (i) value retrieval, extracting specific values annotated in the chart; (ii) trend identification, determining the direction and shape of variable changes; (iii) extremum detection, locating maxima, minima, peaks, or valleys; (iv) statistical aggregation, aggregating information across multiple frames (e.g., counting the amount of distinct chart types appearing in a video), independent of frame order. • Target Competency: Reading chart data and identifying visual variables; aggregating information from multiple video frames. • Evidence: Single frame / multi-frame unordered (aggregation mode). • Distractor Design: At least one distractor has a value within ± 15 % \pm 15\% of the correct answer; at least one distractor is drawn from another visible data point in the same chart; aggregation-mode options are consecutive integers ( N − 1 , N , N + 1 , N + 2 N{-}1,N,N{+}1,N{+}2 ). Chart Element Recognition • Definition: Recognizing basic visual elements of a chart, including chart type, axis labels, units, legends, color encodings, etc. • Target Competency: Chart type identification; visual encoding comprehension. • Evidence: Single frame. • Distractor Design: For chart-type questions, at least one distractor is a visually similar chart family member ( Wu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ) (e.g., area chart vs. line chart, stacked bar vs. grouped bar); for axis-label questions, at least one distractor is a label from another chart in the same video.

blocks.en: Level 2: Temporal Reasoning Cross-Temporal Change • Definition: Cross-temporal data change reasoning, including two modes: (i) change tracking, recording the direction, magnitude, or timing of data changes within the visible time window; (ii) trend extrapolation, predicting future values beyond the video’s time range based on observed trends. • Target Competency: Temporal change tracking; trend extrapolation. • Evidence: Data values or chart states at relevant time points, together with their temporal relationships. • Distractor Design: At least one distractor describes a value from only one time point rather than a temporal difference; at least one distractor gives the opposite direction of change; all options in extrapolation mode must be specific numerical values or narrow ranges, not qualitative descriptions. Cross-Chart Comparison • Definition: Comparing data relationships across charts, including two modes: (i) visual comparison, determining relative relationships among data in two or more charts by visual inspection alone; (ii) arithmetic derivation, performing arithmetic operations (ratios, products, proportions, etc.) on values from multiple sources to obtain derived values not explicitly stated in the video. • Target Competency: Cross-chart integration; cross-source numerical derivation. • Evidence: Relevant values and visual evidence from at least two chart segments. • Distractor Design: At least one distractor is correct for one chart but incorrect when combined with another (single-chart trap); arithmetic-derivation distractors correspond to distinct computational errors (wrong input value, reversed operation, using complement, etc.); all options must agree in thematic direction, differing only in precise visual details. Causal Reasoning • Definition: Identifying causal chains jointly supported by multiple charts in the video. Each option is an independently verifiable visual observation. • Target Competency: Cross-chart causal evidence identification. • Evidence: Observations from at least two chart segments that support the stated causal relationship, including temporal relationships relevant to the claim. • Distractor Design: Correct options must span ≥ \geq 2 chart segments; distractors fall into two types: (A) observations not shown in the video but causally plausible, and (B) details genuinely present in the video but not directly relevant to the stated causal relationship. Argument Synthesis • Definition: Identifying the key evidence in the video’s core argument. Each option is a data fact from a specific chart segment. • Target Competency: Full video argument synthesis; key evidence identification. • Evidence: Chart evidence across multiple narrative stages, considered in the context of the video’s central argument. • Distractor Design: Correct options must span ≥ \geq 2 narrative stages; distractors fall into two types: (A) facts genuinely present in the video but serving only as supporting details rather than key evidence, and (B) evidence that contradicts the argument’s direction or belongs to a different claim.
blocks.zh: 第2级:时间原因跨时间变化 定义: 跨时空数据变化推理,包括两种模式:(一)变化跟踪,记录可见时间窗口内数据变化的方向,规模,或时间; (二)趋势外推,根据所观察到的趋势预测视频时间范围以外的未来值. • 目标能力:时间变化跟踪;趋势外推。 二. 支助 证据:数据值或图表在相关时间点及其时间关系进行说明. • 灾难设计: 至少有一个分出器只描述一个时间点的值,而不是时间差;至少有一个分出器给出了相反的改变方向;外推模式中的所有选项必须是特定的数值或狭长的范围,而不是定性描述. • 定义: 比较图表之间的数据关系,包括两种模式:(一)可视化比较,仅通过可视化检查即可确定两个或两个以上图表中数据之间的相对关系;(二)算术衍生,进行多来源的算术操作(ratios,产品,比例等),以获取视频中未明确说明的出自数值. • 目标能力:跨图集成;跨来源数字推算。 二. 支助 证据:至少两个图表段的相关价值和视觉证据。 • 灾难设计: 至少一个分流器对一个图表是正确的,但在与另一个图表合并时是不正确的(单图陷阱);算术-演化分流器对应不同的计算错误(输入值错误,倒转操作,使用补充等);所有选项都必须在主题方向上达成一致,仅在精确的视觉细节上有所不同. • 定义: 识别视频中多个图表共同支持的因果链. 每个选项都是可独立核查的视觉观察. • 目标能力:交叉图因果证据识别。 二. 支助 证据:至少两个图表部分的意见,这些图表部分支持所述因果关系,包括与索赔有关的时间关系。 • 干扰器设计:正确的选项必须跨越\\ geq 2图表段;干扰器分为两类:(A) 视频中未显示但因果可信的观察,(B) 视频中真实存在但与所述因果关系不直接相关的细节。 论点综述 • 定义: 找出影片核心论点中的关键证据。 每个选项都是特定图表段的数据事实. • 目标能力: 完整视频论证综合;关键证据识别. 二. 支助 证据:从视频中心论点的角度考虑的跨多段叙事阶段的图表证据. · 干扰器设计:正确的选项必须跨越\\geq 2 叙事阶段;干扰器分为两类:(A) 视频中真实存在的事实,但仅用作佐证细节,而不是关键证据;(B) 与论点的方向相矛盾或属于不同主张的证据。

blocks.en: Example. Figure 8 shows a representative L2 question (Argument Synthesis). The video argues that geopolitical headlines sparked a late-day market recovery; the model must select all essential chart observations (from multiple chart segments at different timestamps) that jointly support this argument. Correct options span at least two distinct chart segments, while distractors include facts genuinely present in the video but irrelevant to the stated causal claim. This example shows that Argument Synthesis requires integrating chart evidence from multiple charts at different temporal positions, going beyond single-frame perception.
blocks.zh: 实例。 图8显示一个有代表性的L2问题(参数综合)。 影片认为地缘政治头条引发了后期市场复苏;模型必须选择所有基本图表观测数据(从多个图段在不同的时间戳上),共同支持这一论点. 正确的选项至少跨越两个不同的图表段,而分心者包括视频中真实存在但与所述因果关系无关的事实。 这个例子表明,辩证综合需要在不同的时间位置将多张图表的图表证据整合起来,超越了单帧感知.

blocks.en: Level 3: Narrative Understanding Narrative Structure • Definition: Understanding the video’s narrative structure, including three modes: (i) pattern recognition, identifying narrative patterns from the design space of Yang et al. (2022) ; (ii) data flow comprehension, understanding the organizational order and presentation strategy of data facts; (iii) cross section argumentation, integrating data evidence from two or more non-adjacent argumentative segments to understand the video’s overall argument structure. • Target Competency: Narrative structure comprehension; cross section synthesis. • Evidence: Multiple narrative stages or argument sections, including their presentation sequence for narrative organization and their evidence relationships for cross-section argumentation. • Distractor Design: For pattern recognition and data flow modes, all options must be genuine categories from the same stage of the data stories design space ( Yang et al., 2022 ) , which organizes 14 narrative patterns and their associated data flows across the Setting, Rising-Climax, and Resolution stages (for example, Statistic Hook in the Setting stage, Showing Contrast in the Rising-Climax stage, and Recap in the Resolution stage); cross section distractors are over-generalizations of a single section’s claim or misattributions of argumentative structure. Visual Communication Intent • Definition: Understanding how chart design choices and animation strategies serve data narrative intent. • Target Competency: Design intent comprehension; visual mechanism attribution. • Evidence: Relevant chart-design features and their narrative context, including the animation sequence for questions about animation strategies. • Distractor Design: Options are drawn from the visual communication categories of the same design space; for questions about animation strategies, options are drawn from the six categories of animation techniques, namely entrance, emphasis, exit, transition, data-driven, and temporal animation ( Shi et al., 2021 ) . At least one distractor correctly identifies the visual mechanism but attributes it to the wrong narrative purpose (correct mechanism, wrong intent); at least one distractor correctly identifies the narrative purpose but attributes it to the wrong visual mechanism (correct intent, wrong mechanism). Counterfactual Analysis • Definition: Reasoning about the impact on communication goals when a specific design choice is changed. • Target Competency: Design counterfactual reasoning. • Evidence: The original design and its communication context, including temporal sequences when the proposed change concerns animation or narrative order. • Distractor Design: Alternative designs must be genuinely feasible, not “straw man” proposals; extreme options such as “completely incomprehensible” or “no difference at all” are prohibited; the number of correct answers is not fixed to prevent models from exploiting a fixed answer count. Quality Evaluation • Definition: Making holistic quality assessments of the video’s data presentation, with three variants: the Fidelity variant evaluates data presentation faithfulness; the Expressiveness variant evaluates information communication effectiveness; the Aesthetics variant evaluates visual design quality. • Target Competency: Holistic assessment of fidelity, expressiveness, and aesthetics. • Evidence: Chart content and visual presentation across the relevant video segments; full-video context for the Expressiveness variant. • Distractor Design: All options share the same positive tone, differing only in the specific visual mechanisms identified; extreme wordings such as “severe distortion,” “complete failure,” or “flawless” are prohibited; distractors must point to visual elements genuinely present in the video, not fabricated issues. When a question targets potentially misleading design, the mechanisms considered are drawn from visually detectable misleader categories such as truncated axes, unconventional scale directions, and cherry-picked time ranges ( Ge et al., 2023 ) , and are used only when the issue is genuinely visible in the video.
blocks.zh: 第3级:叙述性理解叙述结构 定义: 理解视频的叙事结构,包括三种模式:(一)图案识别,从杨等的设计空间中识别出叙事模式(2022年); (二)数据流理解,理解数据事实的组织顺序和列报策略; (三)交叉分节论证,从两个或两个以上非相邻论证部分整合数据证据来理解视频的总体论证结构. • 目标能力:叙述结构的理解;跨部门综合。 证据:多叙事阶段或论证部分,包括其叙事组织的表述顺序和交叉论证的证据关系. • 灾难设计: 对于模式识别和数据流模式,所有选项都必须是数据故事设计空间(Yang等人,2022年)同一阶段的真正类别,该阶段组织14个叙事模式及其相关的数据流动,跨越设定、崛起-高潮和分辨率阶段(例如,设定阶段的统计钩、崛起-高潮阶段的对比和分辨率阶段的复刻);跨节分心器是对单一部分的主张或辩证结构的错误描述。 · 视觉通信意图: 了解图表设计选择和动画策略如何服务于数据叙事意图. • 目标能力:设计意图理解;视觉机制归属。 二. 支助 证据:相关的图表设计特征及其叙事背景,包括动画策略问题的动画序列. • 灾难设计:选项取自同一设计空间的视觉通信类别;关于动画战略的问题,选项取自动画技术的六类,即入门,强调,出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出入出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出入出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出入出出入出出入出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出 至少有一个分取器正确识别了视觉机制,但将其归属于错误的叙述目的(正确机制,错误意图);至少一个分取器正确识别了叙述目的,但将其归属于错误的视觉机制(正确意图,错误机制). • 定义: 在改变具体设计选择时,说明对交流目标的影响。 • 目标能力:设计反事实推理。 二. 支助 证据:原始设计及其通信背景,包括拟议更改涉及动画或叙事顺序时的时序. • 灾难设计:替代设计必须真正可行,而不是“粗人”建议;禁止“完全无法理解”或“完全没有差别”等极端选择;正确答案的数量没有固定,以防止模型利用固定答案计数。 • 质量评价定义: 对视频的数据展示进行整体质量评估,有三种变体:Fidelity变体评价数据呈现的忠实;Expressive变体评价信息通信的有效性;Ameregistics变体评价外观设计的质量. • 目标能力:对忠诚、表现和美学的全面评估。 二. 支助 证据:图表内容和跨相关视频段的视觉展示;"表达"变体的全视频上下文. • 灾难设计: 所有选项都具有相同的正调,仅在所确定的具体视觉机制上有所不同;禁止“严重歪曲”、“完全失败”或“毫无障碍”等极端措辞;分心者必须指明视频中真实存在的视觉要素,而不是捏造问题。 当一个问题目标可能误导设计时,考虑的机制会取自可视可探测的误导者类别,如短轴、非常规比例取向和樱桃取出的时间范围(Ge等人,2023年)等,只有在视频中真正可见这一问题时才使用。

blocks.zh: 定义:对视频的数据呈现进行整体质量评估,有三种变体:Fidelity变体评价数据呈现的忠实性;Expressive变体评价信息通信的有效性;Ameregistics变体评价外观设计的质量.

blocks.en: Target Competency: Holistic assessment of fidelity, expressiveness, and aesthetics.
blocks.zh: 目标能力:对忠诚、表现和美学的全面评估。

blocks.en: Evidence: Chart content and visual presentation across the relevant video segments; full-video context for the Expressiveness variant.
blocks.zh: 证据:图表内容和跨相关视频段的视觉展示;"表达"变体的全视频上下文.

blocks.en: Distractor Design: All options share the same positive tone, differing only in the specific visual mechanisms identified; extreme wordings such as “severe distortion,” “complete failure,” or “flawless” are prohibited; distractors must point to visual elements genuinely present in the video, not fabricated issues. When a question targets potentially misleading design, the mechanisms considered are drawn from visually detectable misleader categories such as truncated axes, unconventional scale directions, and cherry-picked time ranges ( Ge et al., 2023 ) , and are used only when the issue is genuinely visible in the video.
blocks.zh: 灾难设计 : 所有选项都具有相同的正调,仅在所确定的具体视觉机制上有所不同;禁止“严重歪曲”、“完全失败”或“毫无障碍”等极端措辞;分心者必须指明视频中真实存在的视觉要素,而不是捏造问题。 当一个提问目标可能误导设计时,所考虑的机制会取自可视可探测的误导者类别,如短轴、非常规比例取向和选取樱桃的时间范围(Ge等人,2023年)等,只有在视频中真正能看到这一问题时才使用。

blocks.en: Example. Figure 9 shows a representative L3 question (Narrative Structure, cross-section argumentation mode). The video discusses “pockets of recession” across multiple labor-market segments presented in non-adjacent sections; the model must synthesize information from these dispersed segments to identify which sector the video characterizes as “resilient.” Distractors correspond to sectors that are genuinely discussed but serve a different narrative role (sectors under pressure rather than resilient ones). This example highlights how L3 questions demand understanding the creator’s narrative design and integrating thematic roles across the full video structure.
blocks.zh: 实例。 图9显示了一个具有代表性的L3问题(Narrative Structure,横截面论证模式). 影片讨论“衰退之手 ” , 涵盖多个劳动力市场部分, 不相邻部分; 模型必须综合这些分散部分的信息, 以确定视频将哪个部门定性为“耐受性 ” 。 分心者对应的是真正讨论但发挥不同叙述作用的部门(压力下的部门而不是弹性部门)。 这个例子突出了L3问题如何要求理解创作者的叙事设计和将主题角色融入整个视频结构.

blocks.en: Appendix B Dataset Construction and Statistics
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据集建设和统计

blocks.en: B.1 Video Collection Pipeline
blocks.zh: B.1 视频收集管道

blocks.en: We collect videos from YouTube through two complementary strategies: channel-level crawling and keyword search. Channel-level crawling covers professional media (Bloomberg, Financial Times, The Economist, WSJ), data journalism organizations (Vox, Our World in Data, Pew Research Center), educational channels (Kurzgesagt, TED-Ed, Khan Academy, 3Blue1Brown), and independent data visualization creators. Keyword search uses multiple query groups (e.g., “data-driven story explanation chart,” “climate change graph explained,” “election results map breakdown,” “public health statistics video”) spanning all five topic domains to supplement long-tail content that channel crawling cannot easily reach.
blocks.zh: 我们通过两个互补策略从YouTube收集视频:频道级爬行和关键词搜索. 频道级爬行覆盖专业媒体(布隆伯格,"金融时报","经济学人",WSJ),数据新闻组织(Vox,Our World in Data,Pew Research Centre),教育频道(Kurzgesagt,TED-Ed,Khan Academy,3 Blue1Brown),独立数据可视化创造者. 关键词搜索使用多个查询组(如“数据驱动的故事解释图表”、“气候变化图表解释”、“选举结果地图分解”、“公共卫生统计视频”),覆盖所有五个主题领域,以补充频道爬行无法轻易到达的长尾内容。

blocks.en: Candidate videos undergo automated filtering (duration range, upload date threshold) and deduplication, followed by round-robin sampling by provisional topic tags. Each video is registered with structured metadata upon ingestion, including upload date, view count, channel information, YouTube category tags, duration, and available subtitle languages, supporting the contamination analysis (Appendix E.9 ) and statistical analyses below.
blocks.zh: 候选视频经过自动过滤(期限范围,上传日期阈值)并进行分解,再由临时主题标记来进行圆形robin采样. 每一段视频在摄入时都有结构化元数据登记,包括上传日期、收视次数、频道信息、YouTube分类标签、持续时间和可用的字幕语言,支持污染分析(附录E.9)和下面的统计分析。

blocks.en: Figure 10: The human review interface for video screening. Annotators can watch the video, view AI-generated annotations, and confirm or correct the data video classification.
blocks.zh: 图10:视频放映的人文评论界面. 注释者可以观看视频,查看AI生成的说明,确认或更正数据视频分类.

blocks.en: Data video identification follows a two-stage pipeline of AI pre-screening and human verification. In the AI pre-screening stage, we feed video frames, subtitle text, and metadata (title, channel, duration, tags) into Gemini-3-Flash, which judges whether the video qualifies as a data video according to the three inclusion criteria in Section 3.1 and outputs structured annotations: if the judgment is negative, the model provides a specific rejection reason (e.g., no visualization, decorative only, live-action dominant, narration dominant); if positive, it further outputs identified visualization types, narrative stage annotations, language prior risk assessment, and key timestamps supporting the judgment. Annotators watch each video in the review interface (Figure 10 ), verify the AI classification, and correct it where necessary.
blocks.zh: 数据视频识别遵循AI预筛选和人机验证的两阶段管道. 在AI预筛选阶段,我们将视频帧,字幕文本,和元数据(标题,频道,持续时间,标记)输入双子座-3-Flash,该视频根据3.1节的3个包含标准判断视频是否有资格作为数据视频,输出结构化说明:如果判断是否定的,模型提供了具体的拒绝理由(例如,没有可视化,只有装饰性,活动作占优势,叙述性占优势);如果是肯定的,它进一步输出可以确定可视化类型,叙事阶段说明,语言前风险评估,以及支持判断的关键时间戳. 注释者在审查界面中观看了每段视频(图10),验证AI分类,并在必要时进行更正.

blocks.en: AI Screening Prompt for Data Video Identification You are an expert annotator for the DataVista data-video benchmark. Your task is to analyze a YouTube video and return a single JSON object with EXACTLY the schema below. Definition of “data video”: A video is a DATA VIDEO if and only if ALL three conditions hold: 1. It contains at least one visible data visualization (chart, graph, statistical map, data table, etc.) backed by real quantitative data. 2. The visualization is CENTRAL and SUSTAINED—it must drive the narrative for a meaningful portion of the video, not appear as a brief location marker, evidence overlay, or decorative insert ( < < 5 s total is insufficient). 3. The primary storytelling mode is DATA-DRIVEN: the charts/graphs are what the audience is meant to read and reason about. CRITICAL rejection criteria — mark “no” if ANY of the following is true: • The video is mainly live-action footage, interviews, or on-the-ground reporting, even if it briefly shows maps or text overlays to locate events. • The only “visualizations” are annotated photos, satellite imagery markups, crime-scene diagrams, or location/timeline graphics used as EVIDENCE in investigative journalism (not as quantitative data presentations). • The main insight is delivered by narration/voiceover; charts merely illustrate what is already stated in words (narration-dominant). • The video uses infographic-style text cards or flow diagrams to explain a PROCESS or POLICY (not to present statistical data trends or comparisons). • The visualization count is 1–2 and they appear only briefly. Output schema (abbreviated; full schema includes all fields below): • is_data_video : “yes” | | “no” • rejection_reason (if “no”): one of {no_visualization, decorative_only, live_action_only, investigative_journalism, narration_dominant, process_explainer, advertisement, pure_text_animation, other} • visualization_types : list from 18 normalized types (bar_chart, line_chart, area_chart, pie_donut_chart, scatter_plot, bubble_chart, map_choropleth, map_symbol, treemap, heatmap, table, flow_diagram, network_graph, timeline_visual, pictograph_isotype, annotated_image, mixed_infographic, other_chart) • visualization_count : “1-2” | | “3-5” | | “6-10” | | “10+” • visualization_dynamic : “static” | | “animated” | | “mixed” • narrative_setting , narrative_rising_climax , narrative_resolution : labels from a predefined narrative design space (e.g., statistic_hook, showing_contrast, recap) • data_flow : primary data-flow strategies (e.g., comparison, ranking, time_series_progression, cause_and_effect) • visual_communication : main visual-communication intents (e.g., emphasize, compare, reveal, summarize) • language_prior_risk : “low” | | “medium” | | “high” — estimates how much key data insight can be obtained from transcript alone • evidence_timestamps : 2–4 key timestamps with brief notes supporting the classification • confidence : 0.0–1.0 The model receives the video (base64-encoded), the subtitle transcript when one is available, and metadata (title, channel, duration, tags) as input.

blocks.en: Videos that pass screening enter structured pre-extraction ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , which compiles a timestamped evidence index of each retained video to support question design. Gemini-3-Flash receives the full video and returns chart segments, narrative stages, argument chapters, and a video digest, with exact time fields required throughout so that annotators can jump to the corresponding segment in the review interface.

blocks.en: Structured Pre-extraction Prompt You are preparing an evidence map for the DataVista data-video benchmark. Watch the full video and return a single JSON object with EXACTLY the fields below. Enumerate every distinct data visualization, partition the video into narrative stages, and surface the moments worth examining. Timestamps must be exact. Output schema: • video_description : a 2–4 sentence summary of the entire video. • chart_segments : every distinct data visualization in the video, each with a stable id ( c1 , c2 , …), a label describing the chart form and its content, a question_reference phrase safe to reuse in question stems, and a time_range in MM:SS-MM:SS . • narrative_stages : the time ranges of setting , rising_climax , and resolution , together with a content-specific reference phrase for each stage. • argument_chapters : 3–8 data-argument units subdividing the narrative stages, each with a time_range , its parent stage , a question_reference phrase, and the key_chart_ids anchoring that unit. Required when the video contains at least four distinct chart segments or exceeds three minutes. • video_digest : a reviewer-facing briefing containing distinct_viz_count and a one-line inventory of the chart families present; quiz_hooks , listing examinable moments with a time_hint , the associated chart_ids , and suggested_levels ; cross_modal_hooks , recording moments where a narration claim can be compared against the value the chart actually shows; and stage_notes , summarizing the visualization activity within each stage. Consistency requirements: distinct_viz_count must equal the length of chart_segments ; every chart_ids entry must reference a declared segment id; video_digest must remain consistent with the segments, stages, and chapters.

blocks.zh: 然后,在将元数据用于问题设计之前,各段的注释者对照视频段核实这一产出,纠正不准确的时间范围和图表描述并补充省略的可视化。

blocks.en: B.3 Question Screening and Quality Review
blocks.zh: B.3 问题筛选和质量审查

blocks.en: B.3.1 Text-Only Filtering
blocks.zh: B.3.1 仅限文本过滤

blocks.en: We use Gemini-3-Flash for single-round text-only answering of candidate questions. The input contains question stems and options, without video frames, subtitles, audio, or reference answers. Predictions are matched against the reference letter for single-answer questions and the complete reference set for multiple-select questions. Matching candidates are filtered out; the rest proceed to human review.
blocks.zh: 我们使用双子座-3-Flash来进行单回合文本只回答候选问题. 输入包含出题和选项,没有视频帧,字幕,音频,或参考答案. 预测与单答问题的参考字母和多选题的完整参考集相匹配. 匹配的候选人被筛选出来;其余的则进行人文审查。

blocks.en: Text-Only Screening Prompt You are an answering module for benchmark screening. You are given a list of multiple-choice questions with NO video or image input. Answer each question using only the question text and options. Hard constraints: • Output ONLY a JSON array of answer strings, one per question, in the same order as the input. • For single-choice questions: one uppercase letter (A/B/C/D). • For multi-select questions: all applicable uppercase letters in alphabetical order, comma-separated, no spaces (e.g., “A,C”). The number of letters is not fixed. • No explanation, no extra fields, no markdown. Just the JSON array. Example output for 3 questions: [“B”, “A,C”, “D”] Questions: Q1. {question stem} A. {option A}   B. {option B}   C. {option C}   D. {option D} … Output (JSON array only):

blocks.en: Of the 28,897 screened candidates, 21,804 (75.5%) are filtered out and 7,093 proceed to human review. Table 2 reports the results by capability level.
blocks.zh: 在28 897名被筛选的候选人中,21 804人(75.5%)被过滤出院,7 093人接受人文审查。 表2按能力水平报告结果。

blocks.en: Table 2: Text-only screening results by capability level.
blocks.zh: 表2:按能力级别分列的仅限文本筛选结果。

blocks.en: To examine whether the filtering effect extends to other models, we sample equally sized sets of retained and filtered-out questions. We prioritize pairs from the same video with matching capability level, question type, and answer format, relaxing these criteria in a predefined order when necessary. Gemini-3.1-Pro, GPT-5, Claude-Sonnet-4.6, Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, and InternVL3.5-38B receive only question stems and options and are scored by exact match. We estimate 95% confidence intervals for the filtered-out-minus-retained accuracy differences using 10,000 video-cluster bootstrap resamples.
blocks.zh: 为了检查过滤效果是否扩展到其他模型,我们抽样了同样大小的一组保留和过滤出的问题。 我们从同一个视频中优先排列配对,具有匹配的能力级别,问题类型,以及回答格式,必要时以预先确定的顺序放松这些标准. 双子座-3.1-Pro,GPT-5,克洛德-索内特-4.6,Quen3-VL-32B-Instruct,和InternVL3.5-38B只接收出问题来源和选项,通过精确的比分得分. 我们估计95%的置信间隔 滤出-减去- 保持的精度差异 使用一万个视频组的靴子

blocks.en: Table 3: Text-only accuracy (%) on retained and filtered-out questions. Differences are filtered-out minus retained, in percentage points, with 95% video-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 表3:保留和过滤出的问题的文本精确度(%)。 差异是过滤出数减去保留数,以百分点计,95%的视频集束靴置信间隔。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , text-only accuracy is 22.9–32.2 percentage points higher on filtered-out questions across all five models. This consistent difference indicates that the filtered-out questions are more readily answerable from question stems and options across model families.
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,在所有五个模型中,只有文本的准确度在过滤出的问题上高出22.9-32.2个百分点。 这种持续的差异表明,被过滤出的问题更容易从问题产生和跨模范家庭的选择中解答。

blocks.en: B.3.2 Human Review
blocks.zh: B.3.2 人类评论

blocks.en: Four reviewers who did not participate in question design review the candidates retained after text-only filtering. Tasks are assigned by video, and each question is checked separately by two reviewers against the original video for clear wording, video-supported reference answers, and plausible distractors.
blocks.zh: 四名没有参加问题设计审查的评审员对只经过文本过滤后保留的候选人进行审查。 任务通过视频来分配,每个问题由两位审查员对照原始视频分别检查,以获得清晰的措辞,视频支持的参考答案,以及可信的分心器.

blocks.en: L1 checks numerical values, units, and the corresponding data entities. L2 checks the completeness of evidence across charts and time points, and the validity of comparisons, calculations, and support relations. L3 checks the evidence underlying narrative and visual-design judgments, including whether alternative answers are equally reasonable.
blocks.zh: L1检查数值,单位,以及相应的数据实体. L2检查跨图表和时间点的证据的完整性,以及比较、计算和支持关系的有效性。 L3检查说明和视觉设计判断所依据的证据,包括替代答案是否同样合理.

blocks.en: Reviewers resolve disagreements through discussion grounded in the original video evidence. Questions requiring revision are edited and their answers and options rechecked; those with unresolved ambiguity are removed. Among candidates retained after text-only filtering, 80.1% pass review, 15.4% pass after manual revision, and 4.5% are rejected.
blocks.zh: 审查者通过基于原始视频证据的讨论解决分歧。 需要修改的问题经过编辑,其答案和选项得到重新检查;未解决的模糊问题被删除. 在经过文本过滤后留用的候选人中,80.1%通过审查,15.4%通过人工修订,4.5%被拒绝。

blocks.en: B.4 Video Source Distribution
blocks.zh: B.4 视频来源的分发

blocks.en: We summarize the most prolific source channels within each topic domain. In the Economy domain, CNBC is the largest contributor (153 videos), followed by Half as Interesting (18) and Financial Times (16). The Society domain draws primarily from Pew Research Center (53), Happy Statistics (15), and Our World in Data (6). The Science domain is mainly from popular science channels such as Two Minute Papers and Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell. The Politics domain concentrates on Vox (73) and Bloomberg Television (19), while the Culture domain features independent creator channels focused on statistics and rankings, such as World Statistic and BarChart Race. Overall, the source channels span four broad categories: professional media outlets, research institutions, educational science-communication channels, and independent data creators, ensuring diversity in both content expertise and visual style.
blocks.zh: 我们总结每个主题领域最丰富的源渠道。 在经济领域,CNBC是最大的贡献者(153个视频),其次是"一半"作为"有趣"(18个)和"金融时报"(16个). 学会域主要取自皮尤研究中心(53),快乐统计(15)和Our World in Data (6). 科学领域主要出自"两分钟论文"和"Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell"等流行科学渠道. 政治领域集中于Vox (73)和Bloomberg Television (19),而"Culture"领域则以独立的创造者频道为特色,专注于统计和排名,如"世界统计"和"Bar Chart Race"等. 总体而言,来源渠道涉及四大类:专业媒体机构、研究机构、教育科学-通信渠道和独立的数据创建者,确保内容专门知识和视觉风格的多样性。

blocks.en: B.5 Topic and Subcategory Distribution
blocks.zh: B.5 专题和分类别分布

blocks.en: Table 4 shows the two-level topic taxonomy of DataVista , comprising five top-level domains further divided into 22 subcategories. The video counts for the five domains are: Economy (404), Culture (173), Politics (152), Society (145), and Science (87). Economy is the largest domain, accounting for 42.0% of videos. This is consistent with economic reporting’s emphasis on quantitative indicators, trends, and comparisons, which lends itself to video narratives organized around data visualizations ( Bu et al., 2026 ) . At the subcategory level, Econ: Market Dashboard (177), Econ: Macro Comparison (115), and Culture: Ranking Race (105) are the three largest subcategories, whereas Politics: Event & Governance (4) and Science: Educational Explainer (5) are among the smallest. Per-domain evaluation and equally weighted domain results are provided in Appendix E.1 .
blocks.zh: 表4显示DataVista的两级主题分类法,包括五个顶级域,进一步分为22个子类. 视频对五个领域进行了统计:经济(404)、文化(173)、政治(152)、社会(145)和科学(87)。 经济是最大的领域,占视频的42.0%. 这符合经济报告对定量指标、趋势和比较的强调,这有利于围绕数据可视化(Bu等,2026年)进行视频叙事。 在子类一级,"Econ:Market Dashboard"(177),"Econ:宏比较"(115)和"Culture:Ranking Race"(105)是三大子类,而"政治:事件与治理"(4)和"科学:教育解释"(5)是最小的. 附录E.1提供了每个领域评价和同等加权领域结果。
