blocks.en: B.6 Video Duration Distribution
blocks.zh: B.6 录像时间

blocks.en: Figure 11: Distribution of video durations (30-second bins).
blocks.zh: 图11:视频持续时间分布(30秒收音机).

blocks.en: Figure 11 shows the histogram of video durations (binned at 30-second intervals). The median duration is approximately 335 seconds ( ≈ \approx 5.6 minutes), with about 45.1% of videos falling within the 60–300 second (1–5 minute) range. The shortest video is 28 seconds and the longest is 900 seconds (15 minutes). The distribution is not unimodal and symmetric: the primary peak is located at the 180–210 second (3–3.5 minute) bin, but secondary bumps appear near 240 seconds and 480 seconds. This reflects the coexistence of two narrative modes: short commentary clips and medium-length explanatory data videos. This distribution is consistent with observations by Amini et al. (2015) and Yang et al. (2022) regarding the typical narrative density of professional data videos.
blocks.zh: 图11显示了视频持续时间的直方图(间隔为30秒). 中位持续时间约为335秒(\\\\ 5.6分),约45.1%的视频在60-300秒(1至5分)范围内. 最短视频为28秒,最长视频为900秒(15分). 分布不是单模式和对称的:主峰位于180–210秒(3–3.5分)的被子(bin)上,但二次起伏出现近240秒480秒. 这反映了两种叙事模式的并存:简短的评论片段和中长的解释性数据视频. 这一分布与阿米尼等人(2015年)和杨等人的观察一致. (2022)关于专业数据视频的典型叙事密度.

blocks.en: B.7 Video View Count Distribution
blocks.zh: B.7 视频视图数分布

blocks.en: Figure 12: Distribution of video view counts ( log 10 \log_{10} scale).
blocks.zh: 图12:视频收视量的分布(log 10\log_{10}比例表).

blocks.en: Figure 12 presents the log 10 \log_{10} -scaled histogram of video view counts (40 equal-width bins; 945 videos have view count records). The median view count is approximately 5,349. About 28.5% of videos have more than 100K views, and approximately 7.0% exceed 1M views. The distribution exhibits a bimodal pattern: the first peak is located near log 10 ≈ 1.6 \log_{10}\approx 1.6 ( ≈ \approx 40 views), corresponding to recently collected videos still in their cold-start phase; the second, broader bump spans log 10 ≈ 2 \log_{10}\approx 2 – 5 5 (thousands to hundreds of thousands), corresponding to the typical reach of mainstream professional media content. This bimodal structure corroborates DataVista ’s simultaneous attention to both timeliness and influence during data collection.
blocks.zh: 图12显示的是log 10\log_{10} - 视频视图计数的直方图(40个等宽的垃圾箱;945个视频有视图计数记录). 中位数为约5,349. 约28.5%的视频拥有超过100K的取景量,约7.0%的取景量超过1M. 分布呈现出双模式模式:第一高峰位于log 10\\ 1.6\ log 10\ 大约1.6(\\\ 大约 40 个视图)附近,与最近收集的视频相对应,视频仍处于冷起阶段;第二高峰则横跨log 10\\ 2\ log 10\ 大约 2 = 5 (千到数十万),与主流专业媒体内容的典型覆盖范围相对应。 这种双模式结构证实了DataVista同时注意数据收集的及时性和影响力。

blocks.en: B.8 Publication Date Distribution
blocks.zh: B.8 出版物的分发日期

blocks.en: Figure 13: Monthly distribution of video upload dates.
blocks.zh: 图13:每月分发视频上传日期.

blocks.en: Figure 13 shows the monthly distribution of video publication dates. Approximately 68.5% of videos were published in or after June 2025; by calendar year, 399 videos (41.5%) were collected from 2025 and 348 videos (36.2%) were published in or after January 2026. A ramp-up trend is visible from mid-2024 through the beginning of 2026, reflecting the dataset’s deliberate strategy of skewing toward more recent content to reduce data contamination risk(see Appendix E.9 for details).
blocks.zh: 图13显示了视频出版日期的每月发行量。 大约68.5%的视频在2025年6月或之后出版;到日历年,从2025年收集了399个视频(41.5%),在2026年1月或之后出版了348个视频(36.2%). 从2024年年中到2026年初,出现了上升趋势,反映了数据集故意采取的战略,向更近期的内容倾斜,以减少数据被污染的风险(详情见附录E.9)。

blocks.en: B.9 Chart Type Distribution
blocks.zh: B.9 图型分布

blocks.en: Table 5: Distribution of chart types across 961 videos (2,210 total entries; ≈ \approx 2.30 per video). Count is the occurrence count for each type; % is its share of all entries. “Other” subsumes miscellaneous and unclassified types.
blocks.zh: 表5:图类型分布于961个视频(2,210个总条目;\\\每个视频约2.30个). 计算是每种类型的发生数;%是其在所有条目中的份额。 “其他”包括各种类型和非分类类型。

blocks.en: Table 5 summarizes the distribution of chart types. We annotated each video with structured visualization type labels; videos containing multiple chart types receive separate entries for each type, so the total number of entries can exceed the number of videos. A total of 18 normalized chart types were identified, yielding 2,210 entries across 961 videos (an average of ≈ \approx 2.30 types per video). The distribution is highly concentrated: bar charts appear in at least 64.9% of videos (624 entries) and line charts in about 42.6% (409 entries); bar, line, and area chart entries together account for approximately 47.9% of all entries. Infographics ( ≈ \approx 12.0% of entries), tables ( ≈ \approx 10.3%), and two map variants (choropleth maps at ≈ \approx 10.3% and symbol maps at ≈ \approx 10.0%, both measured by video coverage rate) also appear frequently. Pie/donut charts, timelines, pictograms, and flow diagrams each fall in the moderate range. Scatter plots, bubble charts, heatmaps, treemaps, and network diagrams belong to the long tail, collectively covering fewer than about 10% of videos when counted by whether at least one such type appears, yet they serve as important probes for model comprehension on less conventional chart types. This distribution aligns well with the content characteristics of professional data videos, which emphasize temporal and categorical comparisons.
blocks.zh: 表5概述了图表类型的分布。 我们用结构化可视化类型的标签给每个视频作注释;包含多个图表类型的视频会获得每个类型的单独条目,因此条目总数可以超过视频. 共确定了18个正版图表类型,在961个视频中共产生2,210个条目(平均每个视频平均为\\\\ 2.30个类型)。 分布高度集中:条形图至少出现在64.9%的视频(624个条目)和约42.6%的行图(409个条目);条、行和区图条目合计约占所有条目的47.9%。 Infographics (\\\ 大约占条目的12.0%),表 (\\\ 大约占10.3%),以及两个地图变体(chopleth map at \\\ 大约占10.3%和符号地图 \\\ 大约占10.0%,都以视频覆盖率衡量)也经常出现. 派克/杜努克图,时间表,象形图,和流图在中度范围内各倒出. 散射地块、气泡图、热映射图、树图和网络图属于长尾图,从至少出现一种类型来看,它们总共覆盖不到10%的视频,但却是了解不太常规的图表类型的重要探测器。 这种分发方式与专业数据视频的内容特征非常一致,这些视频强调时间和绝对的比较。

blocks.en: B.10 Question Count Distribution
blocks.zh: B.10 提问数分配

blocks.en: After text-only filtering and human review, DataVista retains 6,775 questions covering 961 videos. The median number of questions per video is 7, with a mean of 7.0, a range of 1–19, and first and third quartiles of 5 and 9. Videos with 5–10 questions account for 63.1% of the dataset; those with 1–4, 11–15, and at least 16 questions account for 22.3%, 13.4%, and 1.2%, respectively.
blocks.zh: DataVista保留了覆盖961个视频的6,775个问题。 每段视频的中位题数为7个,平均值为7.0个,范围为1-19个;第一和第三位为5分和9分. 有5至10个问题的视频占数据集的63.1%;有1至4、11至15个问题的视频和至少16个问题的视频分别占22.3%、13.4%和1.2%。

blocks.en: L1, L2, and L3 contain 2,817, 1,908, and 2,050 questions, respectively, with per-video medians of 3, 2, and 2. The three levels cover 93.5%, 83.4%, and 88.4% of videos, respectively, so most videos have questions at each level.
blocks.zh: L1,L2和L3分别包含2,817,1,908和2,050个问题,每集视频中位数为3,2和2. 三个级别分别覆盖93.5%,83.4%和88.4%的视频,因此大多数视频在每个级别都有问题.

blocks.en: Appendix C Case Studies
blocks.zh: 附录C 案例研究

blocks.en: This appendix presents representative questions from DataVista as a supplement to Section 4 . The cases are organized by capability level (L1, L2, and L3), using video evidence to explain what each question requires and to analyze differences in the answers of representative models.
blocks.zh: 本附录介绍DataVista提出的代表性问题,作为第4节的补充。 案件按能力级别(L1,L2和L3)排列,利用视频证据解释每个问题需要什么,并分析代表性模型答案的差异.

blocks.en: Each case presents the question and options, timestamped key frames, the basis for the answer, and model responses side by side, with correct answers highlighted in green. The analysis connects evidence to responses: we explain how the key frames support the answer, compare correct selections, omissions, and incorrect choices, and discuss how these differences affect numerical judgments, argument completeness, and design understanding.
blocks.zh: 每个案例都给出了问题和选项,时间戳出的关键框架,答案的基础,以及模式并列的响应,并用绿色突出的正确答案. 分析将证据与答复联系起来:我们解释关键框架如何支持答案,比较正确的选择、遗漏和不正确的选择,并讨论这些差异如何影响数字判断、论据完整性和设计理解。

blocks.en: C.1 Level 1: Data Perception This subsection examines model responses on numerical comparison and visual encoding recognition through quarterly peak identification and legend mapping. The cases require comparing quarterly sales within a specified year and identifying the meaning of a line from its color and style, respectively. We analyze response differences using the displayed values, visual marks, and model selections.
blocks.zh: C.1 第1级:数据感知 本分节通过季度峰值识别和传奇映射,来审查关于数字比较和视觉编码识别的模型响应. 这些案件要求在特定年份内对季度销售进行比较,并从其颜色和样式分别确定一行的含义。 我们用显示的数值、视觉标记和模型选择来分析反应差异。

blocks.en: C.1 Level 1: Data Perception
blocks.zh: C.1 第1级:数据感知

blocks.en: This subsection examines model responses on numerical comparison and visual encoding recognition through quarterly peak identification and legend mapping. The cases require comparing quarterly sales within a specified year and identifying the meaning of a line from its color and style, respectively. We analyze response differences using the displayed values, visual marks, and model selections.
blocks.zh: 本分节通过季度峰值识别和传奇映射,来审查关于数字比较和视觉编码识别的模型响应. 这些案件要求在特定年份内对季度销售进行比较,并从其颜色和样式分别确定一行的含义。 我们用显示的数值、视觉标记和模型选择来分析反应差异。

blocks.en: Figure 14: An example L1 question in DataVista (Data Fact Reading)
blocks.zh: 图14:DataVista中的一例L1问题 (数据事实阅读)

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 14 , the question asks which quarter in 2024 recorded the highest net sales for On Holding. The correct answer (C, Q3 2024) can be determined by visual comparison of bar heights within the 2024 fiscal year, where Q3 ( 754 ​ M 754M ) is the tallest bar. However, all five representative models answer incorrectly: Gemini-3.1-Pro and Qwen3-VL-32B select Q2, while GPT-5, Claude-Sonnet-4.6, and InternVL3.5-38B select Q4. The fourth quarter, selected by three models, records sales of 720 ​ M 720M , approximately 4.5% below the third quarter. This case illustrates that even a basic task such as identifying an annual peak can involve difficulty distinguishing closely valued alternatives, with models selecting the second-highest quarter as the highest.
blocks.zh: 如图14所示,问题在于2024年哪个季度的On Holding净销量最高。 正确的答案(C,Q3 2024)可以通过2024财年内酒吧高位的可视化比较来确定,其中Q3(754 M 754M )是最高的酒吧. 然而,所有五个代表性模型都答错了:双子座-3.1-Pro和Quen3-VL-32B选择了Q2,而GPT-5,克洛德-索内特-4.6,和InternVL3.5-38B选择了Q4. 第四季由3个型号选择,记录了720 M 720M的销量,比第三季低了大约4.5%. 这一案例表明,即使确定年度峰值等基本任务,也难以区分受到高度评价的替代品,模型选择第二高的季度为最高的季度。

blocks.en: Figure 15: An example L1 question in DataVista (Chart Element Recognition).
blocks.zh: 图15:DataVista(图元素识别)中的一例L1问题.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 15 , the question asks what the solid light-blue line represents on a federal funds rate projection chart. The correct answer (C, the historical lower limit) is directly readable from the chart legend, which explicitly maps the solid light-blue line to "Lower limit." Only Gemini-3.1-Pro answers correctly; all other models select B (the projected median rate), assigning the meaning of the grey projection dots to the solid light-blue line. Although the legend explicitly distinguishes the two types of marks, the four models fail to match the specified line to its meaning, revealing difficulty in recognizing the mapping between color, mark shape, and data meaning.
blocks.zh: 如图15所示,问题在于联邦基金比率预测图上所显示的实心光蓝线。 正确的答案(C,即历史下限)可以从图表传说中直接读取,图中明确将固态光蓝线映射到"下限". 只有双子座-3.1-Pro答案正确;所有其他模型都选择了B(预测中位率),将灰色投影点的意义分配给了固态光-蓝色线. 虽然"传说"明确区分了两类标记,但四个模型未能将所指定的行与其意义相匹配,揭示出在识别颜色,标记形状,和数据含义之间的映射时存在困难.

blocks.en: C.2 Level 2: Temporal Reasoning
blocks.zh: C.2 第二级:临时理由

blocks.en: This subsection uses argument synthesis and cross-temporal arithmetic cases to illustrate the requirements of cross-segment evidence integration in L2 temporal reasoning and the corresponding model performance. Argument synthesis requires selecting all key facts from different charts that support the central claim, while cross-temporal arithmetic requires reading data at specified times and calculating the change. The case analyses examine whether models select the complete set of supporting evidence and correctly perform numerical comparisons across time, respectively.
blocks.zh: 本分节使用论证合成和跨时序算法案例来说明L2时序推理中跨分部分证据整合的要求和相应的模型性能. 辩证综合需要从支持中心主张的不同图表中选择所有关键事实,而跨时算术则需要在特定时间读取数据并计算变化. 案例分析检查模型是否分别选择了完整的一套佐证证据并正确进行跨时间的数字比较.

blocks.en: Figure 16: An example L2 question in DataVista (Argument Synthesis).
blocks.zh: 图16:DataVista (Argument Synthesis)中一例L2问题.

blocks.en: Figure 16 shows the video argues that remittances have become a "default pathway" for Nepal’s economy. The model must select all chart-specific data facts that are essential to supporting this argument from across three non-adjacent segments: a geographic map (03:37), an age demographics chart (04:27), and a remittance GDP-share comparison (07:03). The correct answer (B, C, D) requires synthesizing structural push factors (young workforce, landlocked terrain) with the economic outcome (remittance dominance), while option A (a Discord poll result) is factually present but irrelevant to the causal chain. GPT-5 and Gemini-3.1-Pro correctly identify all three essential pieces; the other three models select B and C but omit D. Options B and C concern the population structure and the economic importance of remittances, while D adds the geographic constraints on domestic industrial development. All three answers omit the explanatory link concerning limited domestic development opportunities, leaving the selected evidence incomplete in explaining why remittances have become a "default pathway" for Nepal’s economy.
blocks.zh: 图16显示,影片认为汇款已成为尼泊尔经济的"违约路径". 该模型必须从三个非相邻部分选择对支持这一论点至关重要的所有具体图表数据事实:地理图(03:37),年龄人口图(04:27)和汇款占GDP份额比较(07:03)。 正确的答案(B,C,D)要求将结构推力因素(年轻劳动力,地势内陆)与经济结果(汇款占支配地位)相综合,而选择A(Discord民意测验结果)则实际存在,但与因果链无关. GPT-5和双子座-3.1-Pro正确确定了所有三个基本部分;其他三个模型选择了B和C,但略去D. 选项B和C涉及人口结构和汇款的经济重要性,而D则增加了对国内工业发展的地理限制. 这三个答案都忽略了有关国内发展机会有限的解释性联系,

blocks.en: Figure 17: An example L2 question in DataVista (Cross-Temporal Change).
blocks.zh: 图17:DataVista (Cross-Temporal Change)中一个L2问题的例子.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 17 , the question asks for the total increase in box office earnings between two specific milestones in an animated ranking. The correct answer (D, 274.85 ​ M 274.85M ) requires subtracting the value at the first milestone ( 122.53 ​ M 122.53M at 01:13) from the peak value ( 397.38 ​ M 397.38M at 01:39). Only Gemini-3.1-Pro answers correctly; the remaining four models all select B ( 294.85 ​ M 294.85M ). This shared incorrect answer exceeds the correct increase by 20 ​ M 20M . The question combines basic subtraction with matching data across time: models must locate two specified moments in a continuously updated ranking, read the respective values, and calculate the change. All four models fail to obtain the correct result on this combined task, illustrating that basic numerical operations in dynamic videos also depend on accurate temporal localization and data reading.
blocks.zh: 如图17所示,问题在于动画排名中两个具体里程碑之间的票房收入总额增加。 正确的答案(D,274.85 M 274.85M)要求从最高峰值(397.38 M 397.38M at 01:39)中减去第一个里程碑值(122.53 M 122.53M at 01:13). 只有双子座-3.1-Pro答案正确;其余四个模型都选择了B (294.85 M 294.85M ) 。 这个共享的不正确的答案超过正确增加的20 M 20M 。 这个问题结合了基本减和跨时间的匹配数据:模型必须在不断更新的排名中找到两个指定的时刻,读取相应的值并计算变化. 这四个模型都未能在这项综合任务中获得正确的结果,说明动态视频中的基本数字操作也取决于准确的时间定位和数据读取.

blocks.en: C.3 Level 3: Narrative Understanding
blocks.zh: C.3 第3级:叙述性理解

blocks.en: This subsection uses cases of visual communication intent, counterfactual design, and narrative structure to illustrate the task requirements and model performance in L3 narrative understanding. The three cases examine whether models can identify the visual techniques used in a video, assess the benefits and costs of changing where information is presented, and understand how different charts are organized within a specified segment, respectively. The analyses focus on which design elements models omit or misidentify and how these answer discrepancies affect their interpretation of information emphasis, narrative pacing, and argument structure.
blocks.zh: 本分节使用视觉交流意向,反事实设计和叙事结构等案例来说明L3叙事理解中的任务要求和模型性能. 这三个案例审查模型是否能够识别视频中使用的视觉技术,评估在提供信息的地方进行改变的好处和成本,并了解不同图表是如何在指定的部分内分别排列的。 分析的重点是哪些设计要素模型省略或误认,这些答案差异如何影响其对信息重点、叙述速度和论证结构的解释。

blocks.en: Figure 18: An example L3 question in DataVista (Visual Communication Intent).
blocks.zh: 图18:DataVista (Visual Conference Intent)中一个L3问题的例子.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 18 , the question asks which visual communication techniques the video uses to emphasize demographic statistics. The correct answer (A, D) involves recognizing full-screen bold typography for the "60%" figure and a side-by-side geographic juxtaposition of Nepal and Bhutan populations. These techniques communicate information by emphasizing an individual value and establishing a comparison between countries, respectively. Only Gemini-3.1-Pro correctly identifies both techniques. GPT-5 selects only A, omitting the juxtaposition in D; Claude-Sonnet-4.6, Qwen3-VL-32B, and InternVL3.5-38B select A and B, both omitting D and incorrectly selecting the cut-out people and icons in B. However, the job categories are presented through bar charts and text labels, without these human figures. All models identify the emphasis on an individual value, but all four incorrect answers omit the comparison established through spatial juxtaposition, and three also attribute absent graphical elements to the video design. These responses reflect incomplete understanding of visual communication: they miss the comparative relationship conveyed by the layout and include design judgments unsupported by the displayed content.
blocks.zh: 如图18所示,问题在于视频用何种视觉交流技术强调人口统计。 正确答案(A, D)包括承认“60%”数字的全屏幕粗体打字法,以及尼泊尔和不丹人口的并列地理分布。 这些技术分别通过强调个人价值和建立国家间的比较来传递信息。 只有双子座3.1-Pro正确识别出两种技术. GPT-5只选择了A,省去D中的并列;克洛德-索内特-4.6,Qune3-VL-32B,和InternVL3.5-38B. 选择 A 和 B ,既省略 D ,又错误地选择 B 中的剪切人和图标。 然而,职务类别是通过条形图和文字标签列出的,没有这些人类数字。 所有模型都识别出对单个值的强调,但所有四个不正确的答案都省略了通过空间并列所建立的比较,三个模型也将没有图形元素的属性归于视频设计. 这些反应反映了对视觉通信的不完全理解:它们错过了布局所传达的比较关系并包括了未被所显示内容支持的设计判断.

blocks.en: Figure 19: An example L3 question in DataVista (Counterfactual Analysis).
blocks.zh: 图19:DataVista(事实分析)中的一例L3问题.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 19 , this multiple-select question asks how the narrative impact would change if a Hepatitis B risk table were shown alongside the opening vaccination schedule instead of later. The correct answers are A, B, and D: presenting risk data earlier helps explain vaccination at birth and makes the schedule easier to understand, but may also interrupt the opening overview and increase cognitive load. No model gets this fully correct: Gemini-3.1-Pro and Claude-Sonnet-4.6 select only A, while the others select A and B but miss D. All five models recognize the explanatory role of the risk data but omit the potential information overload from introducing clinical details earlier. This shared omission indicates that their assessments of the design change in this case emphasize local explanatory benefits without fully accounting for its effect on the overall narrative pacing.
blocks.zh: 如图19所示,这个多选题询问,如果在开始接种计划的同时显示乙型肝炎风险表,而不是稍后,叙述性影响将如何改变。 正确的答案是A,B,和D:更早提出风险数据有助于解释出生时接种疫苗的情况并使得时间表更容易理解,但也可能会中断开篇综述并增加认知负荷. 没有模型得到这个完全正确:双子座-3.1-Pro和克洛德-索内特-4.6只选择A,而其他人则选择A和B,但错过了D. 所有五个模型都认识到风险数据的解释性作用,但在早些时候引入临床细节时省略了潜在的信息超载. 这一共同的遗漏表明,他们对本案设计变化的评估强调当地的解释性好处,而没有充分说明其对总体叙述速度的影响。

blocks.en: Figure 20: An example L3 question in DataVista (Narrative Structure).
blocks.zh: 图20:DataVista (Narrative Structure)中的一个例L3问题.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 20 , the question asks which descriptions capture how the video organizes the visual evidence in the House and Senate control-math section. The correct answer is A, B, C. A corresponds to the two seat graphics: 35 Senate seats are up for re-election, and the House stands at 214 Democrats to 218 Republicans. B corresponds to target states marked successively on the map: Maine, North Carolina, and Georgia at 02:29, with Ohio and Michigan added at 02:34. C corresponds to the Cook Report table, which groups House races by competitiveness. D concerns the Texas candidates introduced at the opening and does not belong to this section. Only Gemini-3.1-Pro selects the full set A, B, C. GPT-5 and Claude-Sonnet-4.6 select A and B, omitting the Cook grouping; Qwen3-VL-32B and InternVL3.5-38B select A and C, omitting the states marked successively on the map. The first pair misses how the races are organized by competitiveness, while the second misses the progressive introduction of key states. All four models identify the seat comparison and exclude material from outside the section, but fail to fully recognize how the video combines comparison, progressive highlighting, and categorization to organize its account of the electoral landscape.
blocks.zh: 如图20所示,问题在于影片如何在众议院和参议院控制膜部分组织视觉证据。 正确的答案是A,B,C. A对应两个席位图形:35个参议院席位为连任席位,众议院为214名民主党人至218名共和党人. B对应地图上相继标出的目标州:缅因州,北卡罗来纳州和乔治亚州为02:29,俄亥俄州和密歇根州为02:34. C对应"库克报告表",该表按竞争力对豪斯种族进行分组. D涉及在开幕式上介绍的德克萨斯州候选人,不属于本节. 只有双子座-3.1-Pro选择全集 A, B, C. GPT-5 和 Claude-Sonnet-4.6 选择 A和 B,省略 Cook 组; Qune3-VL-32B和 InternVL3.5-38B 选择 A 和 C,省略地图上相继标记的状态。 第一对错过了比赛如何按照竞争力来组织,而第二对错过了关键国家的渐进引进。 所有四个模型都确定了席位比较,并且排除了部分以外的材料,但未能完全认识到视频如何将比较,渐进地突出,分类结合起来来组织其对选举景观的叙述.

blocks.en: Appendix D Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录D 评价详情

blocks.en: This appendix provides the detailed evaluation settings as a supplement to Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 本附录提供了详细的评价设置,作为第4节的补充。

blocks.en: D.1 Input Organization and Prompt Templates
blocks.zh: D.1 输入组织和即时模板

blocks.en: The main evaluation uses shared answer requirements, with questions from the same video submitted in one request. Closed-source models are queried through official APIs; open-source models use official instruct/chat checkpoints. Decoding is deterministic with temperature 0. Below, we summarize these requirements and the input organization for the conditions without and with subtitles.
blocks.zh: 主要评价采用共同的回答要求,同一视频的问题在一份请求中提交。 封闭源代码模式通过官方API查询;开源代码模式使用官方指令/聊天检查站. 解码有温度决定力 0. 下面,我们总结这些要求和没有附加字幕的条件的投入组织。

blocks.en: Answer Requirements Answer every question using the supplied evidence. Return only a JSON array in question order, with one object per question containing qid , answer , reason , and evidence . Copy each question ID exactly; do not skip, merge, or reorder questions. • Answer: For single-choice questions, return one letter: A, B, C, or D. For multiple-select questions, return comma-separated option letters, such as A,C. Every question requires an option answer. • Reason: Provide the reason supporting the answer. Connect the cited observations to the answer and include key calculations when relevant. For multiple-select questions, explain which options satisfy the question and any important exclusions. Do not repeat the question. • Evidence: Provide an array of source references, each containing source_id , timestamp , and observation . Use only supplied source IDs and keep observations concise and specific to the cited source. Do not use Markdown fences or add text outside the JSON array.
blocks.zh: 答复要求 利用所提供的证据回答每一个问题。 仅按问题顺序返回一个 JSON 阵列, 每个问题有一个对象包含qid、 答案、 理由和证据 。 准确复制每个问题 ID; 不要跳过、 合并或重排问题 。 ^ 回答:对于单选问题,返回一个字母:A,B,C或D. 对于多选题,返回逗号分隔的选项字母,如A,C. 每个问题都需要一个选项答案。 二. 支助 理由:提供支持答案的理由。 将引用的观察与答案连接,并在相关时包括关键计算. 对于多选题,请解释哪些选项满足了问题和任何重要的排除. 不要重复这个问题。 二. 支助 证据:提供一系列来源参考文献,每个参考文献包含源_id、时间戳和观察。 仅使用已提供源代码,并保持对所引用源的观察简洁而具体. 不使用 Markdown 栅栏或添加 JSON 阵列以外的文字 。

blocks.en: Answer: For single-choice questions, return one letter: A, B, C, or D. For multiple-select questions, return comma-separated option letters, such as A,C. Every question requires an option answer.
blocks.zh: 答复: 对于单选题,返回一个字母:A,B,C或D. 对于多选题,返回逗号分隔的选项字母,如A,C. 每个问题都需要一个选项答案。

blocks.en: Reason: Provide the reason supporting the answer. Connect the cited observations to the answer and include key calculations when relevant. For multiple-select questions, explain which options satisfy the question and any important exclusions. Do not repeat the question.
blocks.zh: 理由:提供支持答案的理由。 将引用的观察与答案连接,并在相关时包括关键计算. 对于多个选择的问题,解释哪些选项满足了问题和任何重要的排除. 不要重复这个问题。

blocks.en: Evidence: Provide an array of source references, each containing source_id , timestamp , and observation . Use only supplied source IDs and keep observations concise and specific to the cited source.
blocks.zh: 证据:提供一系列来源参考文献,每个参考文献包含源_id、时间戳和观察。 仅使用已提供源代码,并保持对所引用源的观察简洁而具体.

blocks.en: The condition without subtitles provides 50 uniformly sampled video frames, each labeled with a source ID and timestamp. The subtitle condition adds subtitle text with source IDs and time information to the same frames. Frames and subtitles form the evidence list, followed by the question stems, question types, and options. Both conditions use the same answer requirements. Each question is labeled in the prompt as single-choice or multiple-select.
blocks.zh: 没有字幕的条件提供了50个统一取样的视频帧,每个被标有源代码和时间戳. 字幕条件将带有源ID和时间信息的字幕文本添加到同帧. 框架和字幕构成证据清单,然后是问题来源、问题类型和选项。 两种条件使用相同的答案要求. 每个问题在提示中被标为单选或多选题.

blocks.en: Subtitles are obtained from YouTube. English subtitles are used for 921 videos, of which 386 have a creator-provided English track and 535 have only an automatically generated one. The remaining 40 videos have no English track and fall back to another language, most often Hindi.
blocks.zh: 字幕取自YouTube。 英文字幕用于921个视频,其中386个有创作者提供的英语音轨,535个只有自动生成的音轨. 其余40个视频没有英语音轨,倒回了另一种语言,最常见的是印地语.

blocks.en: Input Organization Available evidence: {Frame source IDs and timestamps; corresponding images are attached.} {Subtitle source IDs, time information, and text; included only with subtitles.} Question 1 | qid={question ID} | SINGLE-CHOICE / MULTIPLE-SELECT {question stem} A) {option A} B) {option B} C) {option C} D) {option D} … Now output the JSON array of exactly N N answer objects.
blocks.zh: 输入组织 现有证据: {Frame source ID and timettamp; 相接的图像。} {字幕源代码、时间信息和文本;只包含字幕。} 问题1 Qid ID / Single-CHOICE / MULTIPLE-SELECT {问题干} A){选项A}B}{选项B}C}{选项C}D}{选项D}... 现在输出精确 N 答案对象的 JSON 阵列 。

blocks.en: D.2 Random Selection and Most-Frequent Answers
blocks.zh: D.2 随机选择和最频繁的回答

blocks.en: We use two baselines without video content to provide random-guessing and answer-frequency references for model performance. Table 6 reports the results.
blocks.zh: 我们使用两个没有视频内容的基线,为模型性能提供随机猜想和答案频率参考. 表6报告了结果。

blocks.en: For single-choice questions, we select uniformly from the four options. For multiple-select questions, we select uniformly from the 15 nonempty option subsets. The exact-match probabilities are therefore 1 / 4 1/4 and 1 / 15 1/15 , respectively. Averaging these per-question probabilities gives the expected accuracy of random selection.
blocks.zh: 对于单选问题,我们从四个选项中统一选择. 对于多个选择的问题,我们从15个非空选项子集中统一选择. 因此,准确的匹配概率分别为1/4 1/4和1/15 1/15. 使用这些逐个问题概率来表示随机选择的预期准确性.

blocks.en: We partition videos into five folds and predict each fold using the most frequent answer in the other four folds. Frequencies are computed separately for single-choice and multiple-select questions, treating each complete option set as an answer for the latter. All questions from the same video remain in one fold. We pool predictions across the five folds to compute exact-match accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们用其他四个折叠中最频繁的答案,将视频分成五个折叠并预测每个折叠. 单选题和多选题的分数分别计算出分数,将每个完整的选项作为后者的答案. 所有来自同一视频的提问仍为一叠. 我们汇集了五叠的预测 来计算准确的匹配率

blocks.en: Table 6: Exact-match accuracy (%) of the statistical baselines. Random selection reports the theoretical expectation; most-frequent answers use video-level five-fold cross-validation.
blocks.zh: 表6:统计基线精确匹配准确度(%)。 随机选择报告理论预期;最常得到的答案使用视频级别为五倍的交叉验证.

blocks.en: D.3 Statistical Reliability
blocks.zh: D.3 统计可靠性

blocks.en: To account for dependence among questions from the same video, we perform 10,000 video-level bootstrap resamples with replacement (seed 42). Each resample retains all available responses from the selected videos and recomputes accuracy using the main-table scoring rule. The 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles form the 95% confidence interval.
blocks.zh: 为了说明同一视频提问的依赖性,我们用替换(种子42)来进行一万个视频级的靴子套。 每个再模拟保留了所选视频中所有可用的响应,并使用主表评分规则来重新计算准确性. 2.5和97.5分之一构成95%的置信间隔.

blocks.en: Table 7: Exact-match accuracy (%) and 95% intervals.
blocks.zh: 表7:精确匹配的准确性(%)和95%的间隔.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 7 , the interval half-widths for overall accuracy are approximately 1.2–1.4 percentage points. Gemini-3.1-Pro outperforms the best open-source model, Qwen3-VL-32B, by 12.7 percentage points, well beyond this margin, and the two 95% intervals do not overlap, indicating that this gap reflects a genuine performance difference rather than sampling noise. The same resolution holds across the full capability range: overall accuracy among the 19 models spans 31.1% for InternVL3-2B to 70.0% for Gemini-3.1-Pro, a 38.9-percentage-point spread that is about 30 times the interval half-width, indicating that the benchmark yields discriminative estimates from the smallest open-source models to the strongest closed-source models.
blocks.zh: 如表7所示,总体准确度的间隔为1.2-1.4个百分点。 双子座-3.1-Pro优于最佳开源模型Qwen3-VL-32B,比这个比值高出了12.7个百分点,两个95%的间隔不相重叠,表明这个差距反映了真正的性能差异而不是取样噪音. 同一分辨率贯穿整个能力范围:在19个模型中,InternVL3-2B的总精度为31.1%至70.0%;双子座-3.1-Pro的精度差为38.9%,约为相距半相距的30倍,表明基准从最小的开源模型到最强的闭源模型得出有差别的估计。

blocks.en: Appendix E Supplementary Experimental Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录E 实验分析

blocks.en: E.1 Domain Performance and Weighting
blocks.zh: E.1 域性能和加权

blocks.en: To assess how domain proportions affect model comparisons, we compute subtitle-condition accuracy for five representative models in Economy, Society, Science, Politics, and Culture, and compare question-weighted accuracy with an equally weighted mean across the five domains.
blocks.zh: 为了评估域比例如何影响模型比较,我们计算经济、社会、科学、政治和文化五个代表性模型的字幕条件精确度,并将问题加权精确度与五个领域同等加权平均值进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 8: Per-domain exact-match accuracy (%) with subtitles. Domain mean gives equal weight to the five domains.
blocks.zh: 表8:带字幕的全域精确匹配精度(%). 域指对五个域给予同等的分量.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 8 , equal domain weighting changes each model’s accuracy by at most 0.9 percentage points and leaves the five-model ranking unchanged, indicating that their aggregate comparison is stable under this reweighting. Relative performance within individual domains can differ ( Li et al., 2024a ) : although Claude-Sonnet-4.6 has lower overall accuracy than GPT-5, it scores 66.0% in Politics compared with GPT-5’s 62.8%.
blocks.zh: 如表8所显示,等域权重最多会改变每个模型的精确度0.9个百分点,并保持五模型的排名不变,表明它们在这种再权重下的总比较是稳定的. 不同领域内部的相对表现可能有所不同(Li等人,2024a): 尽管克劳德-索内特-4.6的总精度低于GPT-5,

blocks.en: E.2 Native Video Input Comparison
blocks.zh: E.2 本地视频输入比较

blocks.en: To examine how input format affects model performance, we compare Gemini-3.1-Pro and Gemini-3-Flash with 50 frames, 50 frames with subtitles, and complete audiovisual input. All three conditions include the question stems and answer options. The audiovisual condition retains the original audio track without additional subtitle text. Table 9 reports the results.
blocks.zh: 为了检查输入格式如何影响模型性能,我们将双子座-3.1-Pro和双子座-3-Flash与50帧,50帧与字幕,以及完整的视听输入进行比较. 这三个条件都包括出问题和答案选项。 视听条件保留了原有的音频音轨,没有附加字幕文本. 表9报告结果。

blocks.en: Table 9: Exact-match accuracy (%) across input conditions. The frame conditions use the same 50 frames, without audio; audiovisual input includes the complete video and original audio.
blocks.zh: 表9:各输入条件精确匹配准确度(%). 帧条件使用相同的50帧,没有音频;视听输入包括完整的视频和原始音频.

blocks.en: Compared with 50 frames alone, complete audiovisual input improves overall accuracy by 5.3 percentage points for Pro and 4.8 for Flash, with the largest gains on L2: 5.9 and 6.4 points, respectively. Inspection of sampled frames, source videos, and model responses links some improvements to briefly displayed evidence. For example, a basketball question asks for the total number of successful shots across two shooting styles, but the results table appears between two sampled frames. Pro answers incorrectly with frame input; with audiovisual input, it reads 18 and 14 successful shots and correctly sums them to 32. Similarly, a nuclear-power question asks about the initial state in 1960, but the sampled frames have already advanced to 1961. Both models answer with the wrong country count under frame input and correctly under audiovisual input. These cases show that sampling the relevant chart does not necessarily capture the values and temporal states required by the question.
blocks.zh: 仅与50个帧相比,完整的视听投入提高了Pro和Flash的总体准确度,分别为5.3个百分点和4.8个百分点,分别是L2:5.9和6.4分的最大收益. 对抽样框架、源视频和模型答复的检查将一些改进与简要显示的证据联系起来。 例如,一个篮球问题询问了两种射击风格中成功射击的总数,但结果表出现在两个被取样的相框之间. Pro错误地用帧输入回答;通过视听输入,它读取了18和14个成功镜头,并正确将镜头计为32个. 同样,一个核电问题询问了1960年的初始状态,但抽样框架已经推进到1961年. 这两种模式在框架投入和视听投入下都用错误的国家数来回答。 这些案例表明,相关图表的抽样不一定能够反映问题所要求的价值和时间状态。

blocks.en: What subtitles can recover depends on what the narration states. For example, the 50% increase needed for a rainfall calculation is absent from the sampled frames but retained in the subtitles. With subtitles, Pro correctly computes 3,000 mm, matching its audiovisual response. In contrast, the basketball narration does not state the successful-shot counts, and Pro remains incorrect after subtitles are added. At the aggregate level, adding subtitles narrows the overall gap between frame-based and audiovisual input to 1.8 points for Pro and 0.4 for Flash.
blocks.zh: 哪些字幕可以恢复,取决于描述的内容. 例如,抽样框架没有显示降雨量计算需要增加50%,但保留在字幕中。 配有字幕,Pro正确计算出3000毫米,与其视听响应相匹配. 相形之下,篮球叙事没有说明成功射入的计数,而Pro在加入字幕后仍然不正确. 总体而言,增加字幕将基于帧和视听输入的总差距缩小到Pro的1.8分和Flash的0.4分。

blocks.en: Complete audiovisual input does not improve every response: relative to frames with subtitles, Pro gains 0.8 points on L2, whereas Flash loses 2.7 points. Our case inspection also identifies errors despite the relevant evidence being available. For example, an industry-wealth ranking chart is visible in both inputs. Both models correctly identify Fashion & Retail as the second-ranked industry with frame input, but answer Manufacturing with audiovisual input. Here, the error concerns reading available chart evidence rather than missing it during sampling.
blocks.zh: 完整的视听输入并不能改善每个响应:相对于带有字幕的帧,Pro在L2上得到0.8分,而Flash则损失了2.7分. 尽管有相关证据,我们的案件检查也发现了错误。 例如,在两种投入中都可以看到工业-财富排名图。 两种模式都正确地将"时尚与零售"确定为有帧输入的第二名产业,但用视听输入回答制造. 在此,错误涉及读取可用的图表证据,而不是在取样时遗漏。

blocks.en: E.3 Test-Time Reasoning
blocks.zh: E.3 联合国 试验时间

blocks.en: The Qwen3-VL entries in Table 1 are Instruct variants. To examine test-time reasoning, we evaluate the corresponding Thinking variants of Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3-VL-32B under the same 50-frame input, with and without subtitles. Other settings follow Section 4 , and the results are in Table 10 .
blocks.zh: 表1中的Quen3-VL条目为教义变种. 为了审查试时推理,我们在相同的50帧输入下,评价了Qune3-VL-8B和Qune3-VL-32B对应的"想"变体,有和没有字幕. 其他设置则遵循第4节,结果见表10。

blocks.en: Table 10: Exact-match accuracy (%) of Qwen3-VL Instruct and Thinking variants.
blocks.zh: 表10 Qwen3-VL指令和思维变体的精确匹配精度(%).

blocks.en: Thinking raises overall accuracy at both scales, from 46.2% to 55.6% for 8B and from 57.3% to 62.9% for 32B, though the gains are uneven across levels. L2 improves the most: without and with subtitles, 8B rises from 28.5% and 33.9% to 51.5% and 53.2%, and 32B from 39.0% and 48.5% to 55.3% and 64.4%. L1 also gains 3.5 to 5.8 percentage points. L3 changes inconsistently: 8B gains 4.7 and 6.9 points, whereas 32B drops from 50.5% and 54.2% to 48.0% and 50.2%.
blocks.zh: 思考提高了两个尺度的总体准确度,8B从46.2%提高到55.6%,32B从57.3%提高到62.9%,尽管各个级别的收益参差不齐。 L2改进最多:没有字幕和字幕,8B从28.5%和33.9%升至51.5%和53.2%;32B从39.0%和48.5%升至55.3%和64.4%. L1也提高了3.5至5.8个百分点. L3变化不一:8B增加4.7分和6.9分,而32B则从50.5%和54.2%下降到48.0%和50.2%。

blocks.en: As with subtitles (Section 4.3 ), Thinking also yields its largest gain on L2. The drop for the 32B model on L3 indicates that additional reasoning time does not necessarily produce a more accurate narrative judgment. Even with Thinking enabled, the strongest open-source result, 65.5% for Qwen3-VL-32B with subtitles, remains below Gemini-3.1-Pro and GPT-5 under the same condition (71.7% and 68.8%) and well below the human score of 91.7%.
blocks.zh: 与字幕一样(第4.3节),思考也为L2带来了最大的收益。 L3上32B模型的下降表明,额外的推理时间并不一定会产生更准确的叙事判断. 即使有了思维能力,最强的开源结果,Qwen3-VL-32B有字幕的65.5%仍然低于双子座3.1-Pro和GPT-5,条件相同(71.7%和68.8%),远远低于91.7%的人类得分.

blocks.en: E.4 Higher Frame Budgets
blocks.zh: E.4 较高的框架预算

blocks.en: To examine performance beyond 50 frames, we extend the inputs of Qwen3-VL-32B and InternVL3.5-38B to 100 frames. Commercial APIs limit the number of images per request, so this comparison focuses on open-source models. Both budgets include subtitles. The 100-frame input retains the original 50 frames and adds samples between them; Table 11 compares the two budgets.
blocks.zh: 为了检查超过50帧的性能,我们将Qune3-VL-32B和InternVL3.5-38B的输入扩展到了100帧. 商业API限制每个请求的图像数量,因此这一比较侧重于开源模型. 这两项预算都包含字幕. 100框架投入保留了原来的50个框架,并在它们之间增加了样本; 表11比较了这两个预算.

blocks.en: Table 11: Exact-match accuracy (%) at 50 and 100 frames with subtitles.
blocks.zh: 表11:50和100帧带有字幕的精确匹配精度(%).

blocks.en: Increasing the budget from 50 to 100 frames raises Qwen’s overall accuracy by 2.6 percentage points and lowers InternVL’s by 0.6. L1 improves for both models, whereas L2 and L3 do not move together: Qwen’s L3 stays at 54.2%, while InternVL declines on L2 and L3. This extends the trend in Section 4.4 . Denser sampling can add visual detail for basic reading, but the gain does not reliably carry over to temporal reasoning or narrative understanding.
blocks.zh: 将预算从50帧增加到100帧,使Quen的总体准确度提高了2.6个百分点并降低了InternVL的0.6个百分点。 两种型号的L1改进了,而L2和L3不移动在一起: Quen的L3保持在54.2%,而InternVL则在L2和L3上下降. 这扩大了第4.4节的趋势。 登泽采样可以为基本读取添加视觉细节,但收益并不能可靠地延续到时间推理或叙事理解.

blocks.en: E.5 Multi-Select Diagnostics
blocks.zh: E.5 多选择诊断

blocks.en: To distinguish option identification from complete answers on multi-select questions, we report option-level precision, recall, and F1 alongside exact match. The statistics cover Causal Reasoning, Argument Synthesis, Narrative Structure, Visual Communication Intent, and Counterfactual Analysis. We compare Gemini-3.1-Pro, GPT-5, Claude-Sonnet-4.6, Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, and InternVL3.5-38B under both subtitle conditions.
blocks.zh: 为了区分选项识别和对多选题的完整答案,我们报告选项级别的精确度、召回度和F1与精确匹配度。 统计数字包括:因果理性、辩证综合、叙述结构、视觉通信意向和反事实分析。 我们比较了双子座-3.1-Pro,GPT-5,克洛德-索内特-4.6,Quen3-VL-32B-Instruct,以及InternVL3.5-38B两个字幕条件.

blocks.en: We compute each metric per question, average within each model, and then average equally across the five models.
blocks.zh: 我们计算每个问题中的每个度量,每个模型中的平均值,然后在五个模型中平均。

blocks.en: Table 12: Multi-select performance (%). Exact match is computed on multi-select items only. Gold and Selected denote the mean numbers of gold and predicted options. Empty or invalid predictions receive zero scores.
blocks.zh: 表12:多选择性能(%). 精确匹配仅在多选择项目上计算 。 Gold and Setch 表示金的平均值和预测的选项. 空或无效的预测得到零分.

blocks.en: Table 12 shows incomplete coverage of correct options across all five multi-select types: under both input conditions, precision exceeds recall, and models select fewer options on average than the gold answers contain. With subtitles, Argument Synthesis reaches 96.0% precision but 83.8% recall and 53.9% exact match. Models identify most of the correct content, but often fail to include all required options. Improving these tasks therefore calls for more complete coverage of the answer set while maintaining accurate option selection.
blocks.zh: 表12显示在所有五个多选择类型中正确选项的涵盖范围不完整:在两种输入条件下,精度都超过召回,模型平均选择的选项比金子答案包含的要少. 通过字幕,"辩证合成"达到了96.0%的精度,但83.8%的回想和53.9%的精确匹配. 模型识别出大多数正确的内容,但往往没有包括所有所需的选项. 因此,要改进这些任务,就必须更全面地涵盖答案集,同时保持准确的选择选项。

blocks.en: Because the number of required options varies across task types, we further group questions by gold answer-set size. As shown in Table 13 , with subtitles, Causal Reasoning has F1 scores of 74.1% and 85.3% in the two- and three-option groups, respectively, lower than the other four task types. Argument Synthesis reaches 90.1% F1 in the three-option group, second only to Counterfactual Analysis, but its exact-match accuracy is 57.7%. These tasks highlight different priorities for improvement: Causal Reasoning requires better identification and coverage of supporting options, whereas Argument Synthesis often yields many correct selections without a complete answer set.
blocks.zh: 由于所需选项的数量因任务类型而异,我们进一步将问题按照金子答案集大小分组. 如表13所显示,带有字幕的"Causal Reasoning"在两个和三个选项组的F1分数分别为74.1%和85.3%,低于其他四个任务类型. 参数合成在"三选项"组中达到90.1%的F1,仅次于"反事实分析",但其精确匹配的精度为57.7%. 这些任务突出了不同的改进重点:因果理性需要更好的识别和涵盖支持选项,而辩证综合往往产生许多正确的选择,而没有完整的答案集.

blocks.en: Table 13: Multi-select EM and F1 (%) by the number of correct options, using the same aggregation as Table 12 .
blocks.zh: 表13:多选择EM和F1(%),按正确选项数计算,使用与表12相同的汇总。

blocks.en: The remaining groups contain one Visual Communication Intent question with a single correct option, for which EM and F1 are both 100% under both conditions, and five Argument Synthesis questions with four correct options. For the latter, EM is 20.0% without subtitles and 32.0% with subtitles; F1 is 76.5% and 83.4%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 其余的分组包含一个具有单一正确选项的可视通信入门问题,其中EM和F1在两个条件下都同时为100%,还有五个有四个正确选项的辩证综合问题. 后者的EM为20.0%无字幕,32.0%有字幕;F1分别为76.5%和83.4%.

blocks.en: E.6 Video Duration Analysis
blocks.zh: E.6 视频持续时间分析

blocks.en: To examine the relationship between video duration and model performance, we group evaluation videos into four duration intervals: at most 3 minutes, 3–6 minutes, 6–9 minutes, and more than 9 minutes. Table 14 reports accuracy for all 19 models under the w/o sub and w/ sub conditions.
blocks.zh: 为了审查视频持续时间和模型性能之间的关系,我们将评价视频分成四个持续时间间隔:最多3分钟,3-6分钟,6-9分钟,超过9分钟. 表14报告所有19个模型在w/o子和w/子条件下的准确性。

blocks.en: Models exhibit different patterns of performance decline on longer videos. GPT-5 achieves approximately 68% accuracy in the first three duration groups, dropping to 59.4% in the longest group. Claude-Sonnet-4.6 shows a gradual decline from 64.1% in the shortest group to 59.0% in the longest. Among open-source models, Qwen3-VL-32B and InternVL3.5-38B score 6.4 and 5.8 percentage points lower on the longest videos than on the shortest. GPT-4o, by comparison, stays between 54.8% and 57.8% across the four groups. These results distinguish accuracy from consistency across durations: GPT-5 outperforms GPT-4o in every group while showing a larger short-to-long gap.
blocks.zh: 模型在较长的视频上表现出不同的性能下降模式. GPT-5在前三个持续组中达到约68%的精度,在最长组中下降到59.4%. Claude-Sonnet-4.6显示,在最短的人群中,从64.1%逐渐下降到了最长的59.0%. 在开源型号中,Qune3-VL-32B和InternVL3.5-38B在最长的视频上得分6.4分和5.8分,比最短的视频低. 相比之下,GPT-4o在四个组别中保持在54.8%至57.8%之间。 这些结果区分了准确性和不同时间段的一致性:GPT-5在每组中都超过了GPT-4o,同时显示了更大的短至长差距.

blocks.en: With subtitles, GPT-5’s accuracy on the longest videos rises from 59.4% to 66.9%, narrowing its short-to-long gap from 8.9 to 1.4 percentage points. Qwen3-VL-32B improves from 53.1% to 60.4% on the longest videos, approaching its 60.7% accuracy on the shortest; Qwen3-VL-8B’s gap similarly shrinks from 6.0 to 0.9 points. Claude-Sonnet-4.6’s gap decreases from 5.1 to 1.2 points. This pattern across closed- and open-source models shows that subtitle information helps these models maintain performance on longer data videos. Gemini-3.1-Pro’s gains are concentrated in the middle duration groups: 4.1 and 9.2 points for 3–6 and 6–9 minutes, respectively, compared with 0.3 points for videos longer than 9 minutes.
blocks.zh: 加上字幕,GPT-5在最长的视频上的准确度从59.4%上升到66.9%,将短到长的差距从8.9个百分点缩小到1.4个百分点. Qwen3-VL-32B在最长的视频上从53.1%提升到60.4%,在最短的视频上接近其60.7%的精度;Qwen3-VL-8B的空隙同样从6.0收缩到0.9分. Claude-Sonnet-4.6的相差从5.1分降至1.2分. 这种跨越封闭和开源模型的模式表明字幕信息有助于这些模型在较长的数据视频上保持性能. 双子座-3.1-Pro的得分集中在中段时间组:4.1分和9.2分分别为3-6分和6-9分,而视频长于9分的得分则为0.3分.

blocks.en: Table 14: Model accuracy (%) across four video-duration intervals, reported separately under w/o sub and w/ sub .
blocks.zh: 表14:四个视频时段的模型准确性(%),在w/o子和w/sub下分别报告。

blocks.en: E.7 Representative Error Cases
blocks.zh: E.7 代表错误案例

blocks.en: To complement the error-type analysis of Gemini-3.1-Pro in Section 4.6 , we present two representative failures in the model’s actual responses. In both cases the model reads the numbers printed on the chart correctly. The failure is that it does not follow a constraint in the question: one shifts the specified time range, and the other ignores the requirement that the evidence come from the chart.
blocks.zh: 为了补充第4.6节中双子座-3.1-Pro的错误类型分析,我们提出模型的实际反应有两个有代表性的失败. 在这两种情况下,模型都正确读取了图表上打印的数字。 失败是它没有遵循问题中的制约:一个是改变指定的时间范围,另一个是忽略了证据来自图表的要求.

blocks.en: Figure 21 is the time-range case. The question asks for the increase from the trough around January 2026 to the peak in February 2026. The model locates the relevant chart, but it is distracted by the more salient one-year increase of 111.91% printed on the chart and answers with that value, rather than computing the trough-to-peak gain over the requested interval (approximately 88%). With multimodal input, the model can be drawn to salient on-chart text and pass over an explicit time window in the question.
blocks.zh: 图21是时间范围案例。 质疑要求从2026年1月左右到2026年2月的高峰从槽上增加. 该模型定位了相关的图表,但被更显著的一年增量111.91%印出在图表和带有该值的答案所分心,而不是计算出所请求间隔的槽到峰的增益(约88%). 通过多模式输入,该模型可被引为图上突出的文本并传递问题中的一个明确的时间窗口。

blocks.en: Figure 21: An instruction-understanding error of Gemini-3.1-Pro. The model is distracted by on-chart text and substitutes the printed one-year change for the requested time-window increase.
blocks.zh: 图21 双子座-3.1-Pro的指令-理解错误. 该模型被图上文本所分心,取而代之的是所要求时间窗口增加的一年印数变化.

blocks.en: Figure 22 is the evidence-source case. The question asks for chart-specific facts that bear on the strategic value of the deal. The frames show Eli Lilly’s intraday gain of 2.52% at 00:42 and Centessa’s (CNTA) intraday jump of 45.58% at 00:54, both printed on the performance cards. The 2034 revenue target of about $2 billion is only spoken around 00:35 and does not appear on any chart. The model treats this narrated figure, together with the two on-chart gains, as supporting evidence and answers A, B, D; the correct answer is A, B. The model can read the chart correctly and still place a number from the narration into an answer that admits only chart facts.
blocks.zh: 图22是证据来源案件。 问题涉及与交易的战略价值有关的图表具体事实。 画面显示Eli Lilly的日内增益为2.52%, 2034年的收入目标约20亿美元,只在00:35左右发表,没有出现在任何图表上. 模型将这个被叙述的数字同两个图上收益一起作为佐证和答案A,B,D;正确的答案是A,B. 模型可以正确读取图表,仍会从叙述中将数字放入只承认图表事实的答案.

blocks.en: Figure 22: An instruction-understanding error of Gemini-3.1-Pro. The question admits only facts shown on the chart, yet the model still treats the narrated 2034 revenue target of $2 billion as supporting evidence.
blocks.zh: 图22:双子座-3.1-Pro的指令-理解错误. 问题只承认图表上显示的事实,而模型仍然将叙述的2034年收入指标20亿美元作为佐证.

blocks.en: E.8 Diagnostic Analysis of an Open-Source Model
blocks.zh: E.8 开源模型诊断分析

blocks.en: We manually inspect 120 randomly sampled incorrect responses from a representative open-source model, Qwen3-VL-32B, with 50-frame input and subtitles. The three categories identified in Section 4.6 are also prominent for this model, though they take somewhat different forms.
blocks.zh: 我们手动检查120个随机抽取的有代表性开源模型Qwen3-VL-32B的不正确反应,并配有50帧输入和字幕. 第4.6节中确定的三个类别对于这一模式来说也是突出的,尽管它们的形式有些不同。

blocks.en: At the basic visual extraction stage, the main bottleneck for the open-source model lies in misreading temporal and structural information. (1) Temporal anchor confusion: when computing the decline in a brand’s sales, the model reads the historical peak value shown in the chart (from 2016) as the current-year figure (2024), causing the subsequent derivation to deviate entirely. (2) Chart structure misjudgment: the model often fails to correctly identify the chart’s axis configuration. For example, given a bar chart whose y y -axis clearly starts at 0%, the model nonetheless claims in its reasoning text that the chart uses a truncated y y -axis to exaggerate the visual difference.
blocks.zh: 在基本的视觉提取阶段,开源模型的主要瓶颈在于误读时间和结构信息. (1)Temperal sock 混淆:当计算出一个品牌销售量的下降时,该模型将图表(从2016年开始)中显示的历史峰值读取为当年的数字(2024年),导致之后的推算完全偏离. (2)图结构判断错误:模型往往无法正确识别图轴配置. 例如,鉴于一个条形图的y-轴明显开始于0%,该模型仍在其推理文本中声称,该图使用截取y-轴来夸大视觉差异。

blocks.en: Most errors that can be localized at the reasoning stage occur when linking facts to a claim. On causal-reasoning and narrative-argument questions, the model typically extracts the correct values and trends from the relevant frames; however, when judging whether these visual facts support a given option’s claim, it frequently reaches the opposite conclusion, failing to translate locally correct facts into valid support for the overall option.
blocks.zh: 在推理阶段可以确定存在的多数错误发生在将事实与索赔联系起来时。 关于因果关系和叙述性论证问题,模型通常从有关框架提取正确的价值和趋势;然而,在判断这些可视事实是否支持某一选择的主张时,它经常得出相反的结论,未能将当地正确的事实转化为对整个选择的有效支持。

blocks.en: This category is particularly prominent in the open-source sample and mostly reflects a mismatch between the model’s internal reasoning and its final output. (1) Option-mapping inconsistency: the model reaches the correct conclusion during its textual reasoning but disconnects from it when producing the final predicted letter. For example, when comparing per-capita GDP between two countries, the model correctly computes a roughly 20-fold difference and states in its rationale that this matches option C, yet its final prediction field contains D. (2) Constraint-scope drift: when a question explicitly restricts the comparison to a specific year, the model disregards this temporal constraint during extraction and mixes in projected or other-year values from the same chart.
blocks.zh: 这一类别在开源样本中尤其突出,并大多反映了模型的内部推理与其最终产出之间的不匹配. (1)选项映射不一致:模型在文字推理过程中得出了正确的结论,但在生成最终预测字母时与模型脱节. 例如,在比较两国的人均GDP时,该模型正确计算了大约20倍的差异,并在其理由中说明,这与选项C相符,但其最终预测领域包含D. (2)受约束范围漂移:当一个问题明确限制与特定年份的比较时,模型在取出时忽略了这种时间限制,并混合了同一图表的预测值或其他年份值.

blocks.en: Overall, although the open-source model demonstrates some competence in extracting data from individual frames, it continues to face challenges in integrating information into a coherent overall picture and maintaining consistency over long videos. Both the difficulty of linking facts to claims and the disconnect between correct internal derivations and final outputs point to the importance of maintaining cross-frame coherence and closely following instructions over long contexts, and suggest exploring candidate-answer verification and selection ( Li et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026b ; Lin et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 总的来说,虽然开放源码模式在从单个框架提取数据方面显示出一定的能力,但在将信息纳入一个连贯的整体图景和保持长视频的一致性方面仍然面临挑战。 将事实与索赔联系起来的困难和正确的内部推论与最后产出之间的脱节,都表明必须保持跨框架的一致性,并在长期背景下密切遵循指示,并建议探讨候选人答复的核实和选择(Li等,2025;Li等,2026a; Li等, 2026b; Lin等, 2025).

blocks.en: E.9 Upload-Time and View-Count Analysis
blocks.zh: E.9 上传时间和视图分析

blocks.en: Publicly available data videos may be included in model pretraining corpora and thereby affect evaluation results. To examine potential data contamination, we group videos by upload time and view count and compare the overall accuracy of the 19 models evaluated in Section 4 across groups, examining whether older or more-viewed videos show a consistent performance advantage.
blocks.zh: 公开提供的数据视频可能包含在模型预训中,从而会影响评价结果. 为了检查潜在的数据污染,我们通过上传时间和取景计数来对视频进行分组,并对第4节所评价的19个模型的总体准确性进行跨组比较,检查老视频或取景较多的视频是否显示出一贯的性能优势.

blocks.en: We first examine whether model performance varies with video upload time. We divide videos into three groups by YouTube upload date: before 2025 (214 videos), within 2025 (399 videos), and on or after 2026-01-01 (348 videos). The results show no consistent accuracy advantage for older videos. Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves 68.9%, 68.8%, and 71.9% across the three groups, all close to its overall accuracy of 70.0% in Table 1 ; GPT-4o achieves 56.1%, 57.3%, and 57.5%, and InternVL3-8B achieves 45.1%, 44.1%, and 46.5%. These three models perform similarly across year groups and attain their highest accuracy on the most recent group. The difference is larger for GPT-5: accuracy on videos published in 2026 is 69.9%, exceeding its 63.2% on pre-2025 videos by 6.7 percentage points. Overall, earlier publication does not correspond to higher accuracy, and models maintain comparable or better performance on recent videos.
blocks.zh: 我们首先检查模型性能是否随视频上传时间而变化. 按YouTube上传日期将视频分为三组:2025年之前(214个视频),2025年间(399个视频),2026-01-01起或之后(348个视频). 结果表明,对更古老的视频来说,没有一贯的准确性优势。 双子座3.1-Pro在三组中分别实现68.9%,68.8%和71.9%,均接近表1中的整体准确度70.0%;GPT-4o实现56.1%,57.3%和57.5%;InternVL3-8B实现45.1%,44.1%和46.5%。 这三种模式在全年组别中表现类似,在最近的组别中达到最高准确度。 GPT-5的差异较大:2026年发布的视频精度为69.9%,超过2025年前视频的63.2%6.7个百分点. 总体而言,更早的出版并不对应更高的准确性,模型在近期的视频上保持可比或更好的性能.

blocks.en: We next examine whether model performance improves with video view count. We divide the 961 videos into four equal-frequency groups by view count, from the lowest (Group 1) to the highest (Group 4). Accuracy does not increase monotonically with view count. GPT-5 achieves 69.1%, 70.7%, 68.4%, and 60.9% across the four groups; Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves 70.7%, 75.7%, 70.6%, and 62.2%; and Qwen3-VL-32B achieves 53.3%, 57.8%, 64.0%, and 54.4%. GPT-5 and Gemini-3.1-Pro both attain their highest accuracy in Group 2 and their lowest in the most-viewed group. Qwen3-VL-32B performs best in Group 3, with a 9.6-percentage-point decline in Group 4. These results show no consistent performance advantage for highly viewed videos: more widely viewed content is not necessarily easier for models to answer correctly.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来检查模型性能是否随着视频的收视量而改善. 我们通过取景计数将961个视频分为4个等频组,从最低(第1组)到最高(第4组). 准确性不会单调地增加视图计数. GPT-5实现69.1%,70.7%,68.4%,60.9%四个组别;双子座-3.1-Pro实现70.7%,75.7%,70.6%,62.2%;Qun3-VL-32B实现53.3%,57.8%,64.0%和54.4%. GPT-5和双子座-3.1-Pro均在2组中达到最高精度,在最受关注的组中达到最低精度. Qwen3-VL-32B在第3组表现最好,第4组下降9.6%,这些结果显示,高收视率的视频没有一贯的性能优势:较广收视的内容不一定更容易让模型正确回答.

blocks.en: Neither analysis shows a systematic performance advantage for older or more widely viewed content.
blocks.zh: 这两种分析都显示,对较老或较广泛阅读的内容而言,有系统的业绩优势。

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: DataVista has the following limitations: (1) As this work focuses on the foundational capability of data video comprehension, data video generation and editing are not yet covered. (2) To ensure objective, standardized, and reproducible evaluation at scale, the benchmark currently relies on multiple-choice questions and does not yet include open-ended subjective items. (3) The benchmark currently consists primarily of English data videos, which limits the evaluation of multilingual data video comprehension.
blocks.zh: DataVista 具有以下局限性: (1) 由于这项工作侧重于数据视频理解的基础能力,尚未涵盖数据视频的生成和编辑。 (2)为确保规模的客观,标准化,再生评价,该基准目前依靠多个选择问题,尚未包括开放式主观项目. (3)目前的基准主要包括英语数据视频,这限制了对多语种数据视频理解的评价.

blocks.en: Future work will extend the evaluation to data video generation and editing, introduce open-ended items along with automated scoring schemes, and gradually expand to multilingual datasets. Building on the rich structured annotations already collected, we plan to construct a fine-tuning dataset to train models for data video understanding. Furthermore, to foster a dynamic research ecosystem, we will establish and maintain an official evaluation website and public leaderboard. This platform will periodically incorporate newly released data videos to expand the benchmark, continuously evaluate the latest models, and support researchers in submitting their custom models for evaluation, thereby driving long-term progress in the field.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将扩大评价范围,使之包括数据视频生成和编辑,引入开放式项目以及自动评分计划,并逐步扩展到多语种数据集。 在已经收集的丰富结构说明的基础上,我们计划构建一个微调数据集,以培训数据视频理解模型。 此外,为了促进动态研究生态系统,我们将建立和维持一个官方评价网站和公共领导板。 该平台将定期纳入新发布的数据视频,以扩大基准,持续评价最新模型,并支持研究人员提交定制模型以供评价,从而推动该领域的长期进展。
